BRAND OWNER ΓÇö full access\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  it(\"brand_owner can GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE\", async () => {\r\n    testState.role = \"brand_owner\";\r\n    testState.memberRoleOverride = \"brand_owner\";\r\n\r\n    // GET list ΓÇö empty\r\n    const getEmpty = await GET(getRequest());\r\n    expect(getEmpty.status).toBe(200);\r\n\r\n    // POST ΓÇö create\r\n    const postRes = await POST(postRequest({ name: \"Acme Corp\" }));\r\n    expect(postRes.status).toBe(201);\r\n    const postData = await responseJson(postRes);\r\n    const newId = (postData.supplier as { id: string }).id;\r\n\r\n    // PATCH ΓÇö update\r\n    const patchRes = await PATCH(\r\n      patchRequest(newId, { name: \"Acme Inc\" }),\r\n      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: newId }) },\r\n    );\r\n    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n\r\n    // DELETE ΓÇö remove\r\n    const delRes = await DELETE(deleteRequest(newId), {\r\n      params: Promise.resolve({ id: newId }),\r\n    });\r\n    expect(delRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  // 3. OPERATIONS MANAGER ΓÇö full access\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  it(\"operations_manager can GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE\", async () => {\r\n    testState.role = \"operations_manager\";\r\n    testState.memberRoleOverride = \"operations_manager\";\r\n\r\n    const getRes = await GET(getRequest());\r\n    expect(getRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n\r\n    const postRes = await POST(postRequest({ name: \"Ops Supplier\" }));\r\n    expect(postRes.status).toBe(201);\r\n\r\n    const newId = (await responseJson(postRes)).supplier as { id: string };\r\n    const patchRes = await PATCH(\r\n      patchRequest(newId.id, { name: \"Updated\" }),\r\n      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: newId.id }) },\r\n    );\r\n    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n\r\n    const delRes = await DELETE(deleteRequest(newId.id), {\r\n      params: Promise.resolve({ id: newId.id }),\r\n    });\r\n    expect(delRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  // 4. CUSTOM ROLE ΓÇö viewer-named roleDef with operations:true\r\n  //\r\n  // The new RBAC uses the canonical `operations` permission key for BOTH\r\n  // read and write. Write prevention now comes exclusively from\r\n  // isReadOnlyRole(roleName), which is true only for \"viewer\".\r\n  //\r\n  // To express \"can read, cannot write\" via a DB-backed custom roleDef:\r\n  //   - roleDef.name MUST equal member.role (trust condition)\r\n  //   - roleDef.name = \"viewer\" so isReadOnlyRole returns true ΓåÆ canWrite=false\r\n  //   - permissions = { operations: true } so canRead=true\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  it(\"custom roleDef with viewer name + operations:true ΓÇö can GET, cannot POST\", async () => {\r\n    // Set up a custom role in DB: name MUST match member.role (\"viewer\")\r\n    testState.roles = {\r\n      \"role-custom-1\": {\r\n        id: \"role-custom-1\",\r\n        name: \"viewer\", // matches memberRoleOverride ΓÇö trust condition passes\r\n        permissions: JSON.stringify({ operations: true }), // canonical key\r\n      },\r\n    };\r\n    testState.memberRoleIdOverride = \"role-custom-1\";\r\n    testState.memberRoleOverride = \"viewer\"; // member.role = \"viewer\"\r\n    testState.role = \"viewer\"; // session role (ignored by resolveSupplierAccess)\r\n\r\n    // GET list ΓÇö should succeed (operations:true ΓåÆ canRead=true)\r\n    const getRes = await GET(getRequest());\r\n    expect(getRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n\r\n    // POST ΓÇö should be blocked (viewer ΓåÆ isReadOnlyRole=true ΓåÆ canWrite=false)\r\n    const postRes = await POST(postRequest({ name: \"Blocked\" }));\r\n    expect(postRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(dbMocks.supplier.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  // 5. ROLE DEMOTION ΓÇö session says \"admin\", DB says \"viewer\"\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  it(\"role demotion: session says admin but DB member is viewer ΓåÆ treated as viewer\", async () => {\r\n    // Session claims admin (stale)\r\n    testState.role = \"admin\";\r\n    // But DB shows viewer (recently demoted)\r\n    testState.memberRoleOverride = \"viewer\";\r\n\r\n    // GET list ΓÇö viewer can read\r\n    const getRes = await GET(getRequest());\r\n    expect(getRes.status).toBe(200);\r\n\r\n    // POST ΓÇö should be blocked because DB says viewer\r\n    const postRes = await POST(postRequest({ name: \"Should Fail\" }));\r\n    expect(postRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(dbMocks.supplier.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\r\n\r\n    // PATCH ΓÇö also blocked\r\n    const seeded = seedSupplier(\"org-a\", { name: \"Existing\" });\r\n    const patchRes = await PATCH(\r\n      patchRequest(seeded.id, { name: \"Hacked\" }),\r\n      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: seeded.id }) },\r\n    );\r\n    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  // 6. MEMBERSHIP REMOVAL ΓÇö session valid but member row deleted\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  it(\"membership removal: session valid but member row deleted ΓåÆ all requests 403\", async () => {\r\n    testState.role = \"brand_owner\";\r\n    testState.memberRemoved = true;\r\n\r\n    // GET list ΓÇö blocked\r\n    const getRes = await GET(getRequest());\r\n    expect(getRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n\r\n    // GET single ΓÇö blocked\r\n    const seeded = seedSupplier(\"org-a\", { name: \"Existing\" });\r\n    const getIdRes = await GET_ID(getRequest(\"\"), {\r\n      params: Promise.resolve({ id: seeded.id }),\r\n    });\r\n    expect(getIdRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n\r\n    // POST ΓÇö blocked\r\n    const postRes = await POST(postRequest({ name: \"Blocked\" }));\r\n    expect(postRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(dbMocks.supplier.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\r\n\r\n    // PATCH ΓÇö blocked\r\n    const patchRes = await PATCH(\r\n      patchRequest(seeded.id, { name: \"Blocked\" }),\r\n      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: seeded.id }) },\r\n    );\r\n    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n    // FIX: route uses updateMany now\r\n    expect(dbMocks.supplier.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\r\n\r\n    // DELETE ΓÇö blocked\r\n    const delRes = await DELETE(deleteRequest(seeded.id), {\r\n      params: Promise.resolve({ id: seeded.id }),\r\n    });\r\n    expect(delRes.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(dbMocks.supplier.deleteMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  // 7. CROSS-ORGANIZATION access ΓÇö user from org A tries supplier in org B\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  it(\"cross-org: user from org A cannot read/modify supplier from org B ΓåÆ 404\", async () => {\r\n    testState.role = \"brand_owner\";\r\n    testState.memberRoleOverride = \"brand_owner\";\r\n\r\n    // Seed a supplier in org-b (different org)\r\n    const orgBSupplier = seedSupplier(\"org-b\", { name: \"Other Org's Supplier\" });\r\n\r\n    // GET single ΓÇö 404 (existence hidden, not 403)\r\n    const getIdRes = await GET_ID(getRequest(\"\"), {\r\n      params: Promise.resolve({ id: orgBSupplier.id }),\r\n    });\r\n    expect(getIdRes.status).toBe(404);\r\n\r\n    // PATCH ΓÇö 404\r\n    const patchRes = await PATCH(\r\n      patchRequest(orgBSupplier.id, { name: \"Hacked\" }),\r\n      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: orgBSupplier.id }) },\r\n    );\r\n    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(404);\r\n    // FIX: route uses updateMany now ΓÇö and it IS called (with org-a scope)\r\n    // but count=0 ΓåÆ 404. We don't assert \"not called\" here because the route\r\n    // always calls updateMany; the safety comes from the org-scoped where.\r\n    // Instead, verify the org-b supplier was NOT modified:\r\n    expect(testState.suppliers[0].name).toBe(\"Other Org's Supplier\");\r\n\r\n    // DELETE ΓÇö 404\r\n    const delRes = await DELETE(deleteRequest(orgBSupplier.id), {\r\n      params: Promise.resolve({ id: orgBSupplier.id }),\r\n    });\r\n    expect(delRes.status).toBe(404);\r\n\r\n    // deleteMany IS called ΓÇö but scoped to the user's org (org-a), so it\r\n    // matches nothing and returns count:0. The route then returns 404.\r\n    // This proves the route NEVER tries to delete without org scoping.\r\n    expect(dbMocks.supplier.deleteMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\r\n      where: { id: orgBSupplier.id, organizationId: \"org-a\" },\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    // Critical: org-b supplier must STILL exist (was not deleted)\r\n    expect(testState.suppliers.length).toBe(1);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // className=\"h-[320px] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 rounded-lg animate-pulse\" />\r\n      </CardContent>\r\n    </Card>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ KPI Card Component ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\ninterface KPICardProps {\r\n  title: string;\r\n  value: string;\r\n  icon: React.ElementType;\r\n  trend?: number;\r\n  gradientClass?: string;\r\n  iconColorClass?: string;\r\n  index: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction KPICard({ title, value, icon: \"premium-dark\";\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <motion.div\r\n      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}\r\n      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}\r\n      transition={{ delay: index * 0.04, duration: 0.35      )}>\r\n                {title}\r\n              </p>\r\n              <p className={cn(\"text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold truncate\",\r\n                isDark ? \"text-white\" :        <span>{Math.abs(trend).toFixed(1)}%</span>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className={cn(\r\n              \"h-10 w-10 rounded-xl flex </Card>\r\n    </motion.div>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ CSV Export Helper {\r\n  try {\r\n    const lines: string[] = [];\r\n\r\n    // Summary\r\n    lines.push(\"Revenue Analytics Summary\");\r\n    lines.push(\"Metric,Value\");\r\n    lines.push(`Total ============================================================================\r\n\r\nfunction VoiceRecordingBar({\r\n  isRecording,\r\n  recordingTime,\r\n  isDark,\r\n  isGold,\r\n  onCancel,\r\n  onStop,\r\n}: {\r\n  isRecording: boolean;\r\n  recordingTime: number;\r\n  isDark: boolean;\r\n  isGold: boolean;\r\n  onCancel: () => void;\r\n  onStop: (blob: Blob) => void;\r\n}) {\r\n  const    // Try audio/webm first, fallback to audio/ogg, then default\r\n        let mimeType = \"audio/webm\";\r\n        if (!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType)) {\r\n          mimeType = \"audio/ogg\";\r\n        }\r\n        if (!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType)) {\r\n          mimeType = \"\";\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        const options: MediaRecorderOptions = {};\r\n        if       if (e.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(e.data);\r\n        };\r\n\r\n        recorder.onstop = () => {\r\n          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());\r\n          if (cancelled) {\r\n            chunksRef.current = [];\r\n            return;\r\n          }\r\n          const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType || \"audio/webm\" });\r\n          if (blob.size >   onCancel();\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (isRecording) {\r\n      setTime(0);\r\n      startRecording();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    return () => {\r\n      cancelled = true;\r\n      if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state === \"recording\") {\r\n        mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());\r\n        try { mediaRecorderRef.current.stop(); } catch {}\r\n      }\r\n      if (timerRef.current) {\r\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\r\n        timerRef.current = null;\r\n      }\r\n      chunksRef.current = [];\r\n    };\r\n  }, [isRecording, onCancel]);\r\n\r\n  const stopRecording = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state === \"recording\") {\r\n      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();\r\n    }\r\n    if (timerRef.current) {\r\n      clearInterval(timerRef.current);\r\n      timerRef.current = null;\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const cancelRecording = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state === \"recording\") {\r\n      mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());\r\n      try { mediaRecorderRef.current.stop(); } catch {}\r\n    }\r\n    if (timerRef.current) {\r\n      clearInterval(timerRef.current);\r\n      timerRef.current = null;\r\n    }\r\n    chunksRef.current = [];\r\n    setTime(0);\r\n    onCancel();\r\n  }, [onCancel]);\r\n\r\n  if (!isRecording) return gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border ${\r\n        isDark ? \"bg-red-500/5 border-red-500/20\" : \"bg-red-50 border-red-200\"\r\n      }`}\r\n    >\r\n      {/* Pulsing red dot */}\r\n      <div className=\"relative\">\r\n        <div className=\"h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-red-500\" />\r\n        <div className=\"absolute inset-0 h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-ping opacity-40\" />\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\">\r\n        <p className={`text-xs font-medium ${isDark ? \"text-red-300\" : \"text-red-700\"}`}>\r\n          Recording Voice Note\r\n        </p>\r\n        <p className={`text-[10px] ${isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-500\"}`}>\r\n          {formatDuration(time)} / {formatDuration(MAX_VOICE_DURATION)}\r\n        </p>\r\n        {/* Waveform simulation */}\r\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-px mt-1\">\r\n          {Array.from({ length: 20 }).map((_, i) => (\r\n            <motion.div\r\n 4],\r\n              }}\r\n              transition={{\r\n                duration: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,\r\n                repeat: Infinity,\r\n                delay: i * 0.05,\r\n              }}\r\n            />\r\n          ))}\r\n        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n      <Button\r\n        variant=\"ghost\"\r\n        size=\"sm\"\r\n        className=\"h-7 w-7 p-0 text-slate-400 size=\"sm\"\r\n        className={`h-7 w-7 p-0 ${isGold ? \"bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white\" : \"bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white\"}`}\r\n        onClick={stopRecording}\r\n        title=\"Send\"\r\n      >\r\n        <Send className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\r\n      </Button>\r\n    </motion.div>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\n// \"@/components/ui/select\";\r\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\r\nimport { toast } from \"sonner\";\r\nimport { motion, AnimatePresence } from \"framer-motion\";\r\nimport {\r\n  MessageSquare, Send, Inbox, Pin, Archive,\r\n  RefreshCw, Loader2, Building2, User, Mail, Clock, Paperclip,\r\n  CheckCircle2, FileText, Calendar, Sparkles,\r\n  TrendingUp, Receipt, Lightbulb, Bell, Tag,\r\n  Search, X, Upload, CreditCard, ExternalLink,\r\n} from \"lucide-react\";\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇ Types ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\ninterface MessageAction {\r\n  id: string;\r\n  label: string;\r\n  type: \"renew_subscription\" | \"upload_payment_proof\" | \"view_invoice\" | \"view_report\" | \"open_billing\" | \"dismiss\" | \"custom_url\";\r\n  payload?: Record<string, any>;\r\n  style?: \"primary\" | \"secondary\" | \"danger\" | \"ghost\";\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface Message {\r\n  id: string;\r\n  threadId: string;\r\n  direction: \"admin_to_client\" | \"client_to_admin\";\r\n  senderName: string;\r\n  senderEmail: string;\r\n  senderRole: string;\r\n  category: string;\r\n  subject: string;\r\n  body: string;\r\n  attachments: any[] | null;\r\n  priority: string;\r\n  isReadByAdmin: boolean;\r\n  isReadByClient: boolean;\r\n  isPinned: boolean;\r\n  isArchived: boolean;\r\n  sentAt: string;\r\n  readAt: string | null;\r\n  deadlineDate: string | null;\r\n  // Phase 16\r\n  actions?: MessageAction[] | null;\r\n  metadata?: Record<string, any> | null;\r\n  isSystemMessage?: boolean;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface Thread {\r\n  threadId: string;\r\n  subject: string;\r\n  category: string;\r\n  priority: string;\r\n  isPinned: boolean;\r\n  messages: Message[];\r\n  lastMessageAt: string;\r\n  unreadCount: number;\r\n  deadlineDate: string | null;\r\n  attachments: any[];\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇ Category config (mirrors admin) ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\nconst CATEGORY_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; icon: any; color: string; bg: string; border: string }> = {\r\n  deadline: { label: \"Deadline\", icon: Calendar, color: \"text-rose-400\", bg: \"bg-rose-500/10\", border: \"border-rose-500/30\" },\r\n  subscription_features: { label: \"Subscription\", icon: Sparkles, color: \"text-amber-400\", bg: \"bg-amber-500/10\", border: \"border-amber-500/30\" },\r\n  document: { label: \"Document\", icon: FileText, color: \"text-blue-400\", bg: \"bg-blue-500/10\", border: \"border-blue-500/30\" },\r\n  improvements: { label: \"Improvements\", icon: Lightbulb, color: \"text-emerald-400\", bg: \"bg-emerald-500/10\", border: \"border-emerald-500/30\" },\r\n  invoice: { label: \"Invoice\", icon: Receipt, color: \"text-purple-400\", bg: \"bg-purple-500/10\", border: \"border-purple-500/30\" },\r\n  report: { label: \"Report\", icon: TrendingUp, color: \"text-cyan-400\", bg: \"bg-cyan-500/10\", border: \"border-cyan-500/30\" },\r\n  onboarding: { label: \"Onboarding\", icon: User, color: \"text-indigo-400\", bg: \"bg-indigo-500/10\", border: \"border-indigo-500/30\" },\r\n  billing: { label: \"Billing\", icon: Receipt, color: \"text-yellow-400\", bg: \"bg-yellow-500/10\", border: \"border-yellow-500/30\" },\r\n  general: { label: \"General\", icon: MessageSquare, color: \"text-slate-400\", bg: \"bg-slate-500/10\", border: \"border-slate-500/30\" },\r\n};\r\n\r\nfunction fmtDateTime(s: string | null | undefined): string {\r\n  if (!s) return \"ΓÇö\";\r\n  return new Date(s).toLocaleString(\"en-PK\", {\r\n    day: \"2-digit\", month: \"short\", year: \"numeric\",\r\n    hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\",\r\n  });\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction fmtRelative(s: string | null | undefined): string {\r\n  if (!s) return \"ΓÇö\";\r\n  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(s).getTime();\r\n  const min = Math.floor(diff / 60000);\r\n  if (min < 1) return \"just now\";\r\n  if (min < 60) return `${min}m ago`;\r\n  const hr = Math.floor(min / 60);\r\n  if (hr < 24) return `${hr}h ago`;\r\n  const day = Math.floor(hr / 24);\r\n  if (day < 7) return `${day}d ago`;\r\n  return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString(\"en-PK\", { day: \"2-digit\", month: \"short\" });\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇ Main Component ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\nexport function ClientInboxPage() {\r\n  const { organization, appTheme } = useValtrioxStore();\r\n  const isDark = appTheme !== \"light\";\r\n\r\n  const [threads, setThreads] = useState<Thread[]>([]);\r\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\r\n  const [selectedThread, setSelectedThread] = useState<Thread | null>(null);\r\n  const [threadMessages, setThreadMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);\r\n  const [loadingThread, setLoadingThread] = useState(false);\r\n\r\n  // Filters\r\n  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState<string>(\"\");\r\n  const [filterUnread, setFilterUnread] = useState(false);\r\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(\"\");\r\n\r\n  // Reply state\r\n  const [replyBody, setReplyBody] = useState(\"\");\r\n  const [replying, setReplying] = useState(false);\r\n\r\n  const cardBg = isDark ? \"bg-white/[0.03] border-white/[0.06]\" : \"bg-white border-slate-200\";\r\n  const inputBg = isDark ? \"border-white/[0.1] bg-white/[0.03]\" : \"\";\r\n  const textPrimary = isDark ? \"text-white\" : \"text-slate-900\";\r\n  const textSecondary = isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-500\";\r\n  const textMuted = isDark ? \"text-slate-500\" : \"text-slate-400\";\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Fetch inbox ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const fetchInbox = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    if (!organization?.id) return;\r\n    setLoading(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const params = new URLSearchParams();\r\n      if (filterCategory) params.set(\"category\", filterCategory);\r\n      if (filterUnread) params.set(\"unreadOnly\", \"true\");\r\n\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/communications/inbox?${params.toString()}`);\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        const data = await res.json();\r\n        setThreads(data.threads || []);\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(\"Failed to load inbox\");\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Network error\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setLoading(false);\r\n    }\r\n  }, [organization?.id, filterCategory, filterUnread]);\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    fetchInbox();\r\n  }, [fetchInbox]);\r\n\r\n  // Filter by search\r\n  const filteredThreads = useMemo(() => {\r\n    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return threads;\r\n    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();\r\n    return threads.filter((t) =>\r\n      t.subject.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\r\n      t.messages.some((m) => m.body.toLowerCase().includes(q))\r\n    );\r\n  }, [threads, searchQuery]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Open a thread ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const openThread = async (thread: Thread) => {\r\n    setSelectedThread(thread);\r\n    setThreadMessages([]);\r\n    setLoadingThread(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const firstMsg = thread.messages[0];\r\n      if (!firstMsg) {\r\n        setThreadMessages([]);\r\n        setLoadingThread(false);\r\n        return;\r\n      }\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/communications/${firstMsg.id}`);\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        const data = await res.json();\r\n        setThreadMessages(data.thread || []);\r\n        // Mark as read locally\r\n        setThreads((prev) =>\r\n          prev.map((t) =>\r\n            t.threadId === thread.threadId\r\n              ? { ...t, unreadCount: 0, messages: data.thread || t.messages }\r\n              : t\r\n          )\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Failed to load thread\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setLoadingThread(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Phase 16: Handle action button click on a message ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  // Routes the action to the right surface (navigation, modal, or external URL).\r\n  const handleMessageAction = async (msg: Message, action: MessageAction) => {\r\n    if (!action || !action.type) return;\r\n    const payload = action.payload || {};\r\n    switch (action.type) {\r\n      case \"open_billing\": {\r\n        // Navigate to the Billing & Plans page (subscriptions)\r\n        const { setActiveSection } = useValtrioxStore.getState();\r\n        setActiveSection(\"subscriptions\");\r\n        toast.success(\"Opening Billing & PlansΓÇª\");\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      case \"renew_subscription\": {\r\n        // Navigate to subscriptions and pre-fill the renewal form\r\n        const { setActiveSection } = useValtrioxStore.getState();\r\n        setActiveSection(\"subscriptions\");\r\n        // Stash the pre-fill payload in sessionStorage so the subscriptions\r\n        // page can pick it up after the route switch.\r\n        try {\r\n          sessionStorage.setItem(\r\n            \"pendingRenewalPrefill\",\r\n            JSON.stringify({\r\n              planId: msg.threadId,\r\n            })\r\n          );\r\n        } catch {}\r\n        toast.success(\"Opening subscription renewal formΓÇª\");\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      case \"upload_payment_proof\": {\r\n        const { setActiveSection } = useValtrioxStore.getState();\r\n        setActiveSection(\"subscriptions\");\r\n        try {\r\n          sessionStorage.setItem(\r\n            \"pendingPaymentUpload\",\r\n            JSON.stringify({\r\n              planId: payload.planId,\r\n              amount: payload.amount,\r\n              billingCycle: payload.billingCycle,\r\n              invoiceId: payload.invoiceId,\r\n              sourceMessageId: msg.id,\r\n              sourceThreadId: msg.threadId,\r\n            })\r\n          );\r\n        } catch {}\r\n        toast.success(\"Opening payment upload formΓÇª\");\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      case \"view_invoice\": {\r\n        const { setActiveSection } = useValtrioxStore.getState();\r\n        setActiveSection(\"invoice-management\");\r\n        try {\r\n          sessionStorage.setItem(\"pendingInvoiceId\", String(payload.invoiceId || \"\"));\r\n        } catch {}\r\n        toast.success(\"Opening invoiceΓÇª\");\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      case \"view_report\": {\r\n        const { setActiveSection } = useValtrioxStore.getState();\r\n        setActiveSection(\"reports\");\r\n        try {\r\n          sessionStorage.setItem(\"pendingReportId\", String(payload.reportId || \"\"));\r\n        } catch {}\r\n        toast.success(\"Opening reportΓÇª\");\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      case \"custom_url\": {\r\n        if (payload.url) {\r\n          window.open(String(payload.url), \"_blank\", \"noopener,noreferrer\");\r\n        }\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      case \"dismiss\": {\r\n        // No-op: just visually dismiss the action row by marking it\r\n        toast.info(\"Action dismissed\");\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n      default:\r\n        toast.error(`Unknown action: ${action.type}`);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Reply ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const handleReply = async () => {\r\n    if (!selectedThread || !replyBody.trim()) {\r\n      toast.error(\"Reply body is required\");\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    setReplying(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const lastMsg = \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify({ body: replyBody.trim() }),\r\n      });\r\n      const data = await res.json();\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        toast.success(\"Reply sent to Valtriox admin\");\r\n        setReplyBody(\"\");\r\n        setThreadMessages((prev) => [...prev, data.reply]);\r\n        await fetchInbox();\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(data.error || \"Failed to send reply\");\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Network error\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setReplying(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const stats = useMemo(() => ({\r\n    total: threads.length,\r\n    unread: threads.reduce((s, t) => s + t.unreadCount, 0),\r\n    pinned: threads.filter((t) => t.isPinned).length,\r\n    deadlines: threads.filter((t) => t.category === \"deadline\").length,\r\n  }), [threads]);\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <div className=\"space-y-4 p-4 md:p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto\">\r\n      {/* Header */}\r\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3\">\r\n        <div>\r\n          <h1 className={cn(\"text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2\", textPrimary)}>\r\n            <Inbox className=\"h-6 w-6 text-amber-500\" />\r\n            Messages from Valtriox\r\n          </h1>\r\n          <p className={cn(\"text-sm mt-1\", textSecondary)}>Unread</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <p className=\"text-xl font-bold text-rose-400\">{stats.unread}</p>\r\n          </CardContent>\r\n        </Card>\r\n        <Card        <p className={cn(\"text-xs\", textSecondary)}>Pinned</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <p className=\"text-xl font-bold text-amber-400\">{stats.pinned}</p>\r\n          </CardContent>\r\n        </Card>\r\n        <Card className={cardBg}>\r\n          <CardContent className=\"p-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-1\">\r\n              <Calendar className=\"h-4 w-4 text-rose-400\" />\r\n              <p className={cn(\"text-xs\", textSecondary)}>Deadlines</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <p className=\"text-xl font-bold              className={cn(\"pl-9\", inputBg)}\r\n            />\r\n            {searchQuery && (\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setSearchQuery(\"\")}\r\n                className=\"absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300\"\r\n              >\r\n                <X className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\r\n              </button>\r\n            )}\r\n          </div>\r\n          <Select value={filterCategory || \"all\"} onValueChange={(v) => setFilterCategory(v === \"all\" ? \"\" : v)}>\r\n            <SelectTrigger          </SelectItem>\r\n              ))}\r\n            </SelectContent>\r\n          </Select>\r\n          <Button\r\n            variant={filterUnread ? \"default\" : \"outline\"}\r\n            onClick={() => setFilterUnread(!filterUnread)}\r\n            className=\"gap-1.5\"\r\n          >\r\n            <Bell className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" /> Unread\r\n          </Button>\r\n        </CardContent>\r\n      </Card>\r\n\r\n      {/* 2-pane layout */}\r\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[380px_1fr] gap-4 min-h-[600px]\">\r\n        {/* Thread list */}\r\n        <Card className={cn(cardBg, \"lg:max-h-[80vh] lg:overflow-y-auto\")}>\r\n          <CardHeader className=\"pb-2 sticky top-0 bg-inherit z-10 backdrop-blur-sm\">\r\n            <CardTitle           {filteredThreads.length}\r\n              </Badge>\r\n            </CardTitle>\r\n          </CardHeader>\r\n          <CardContent className=\"p-2 space-y-1\">\r\n            {loading ?              </div>\r\n            ) : (\r\n              <AnimatePresence mode=\"popLayout\">\r\n                {filteredThreads.map((thread) => {\r\n                  const cat =        const isSelected = selectedThread?.threadId === thread.threadId;\r\n                  return (\r\n                    <motion.div\r\n                      key={thread.threadId}\r\n                      layout\r\n                      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}\r\n                      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}\r\n                      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}\r\n                      transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}\r\n                    >\r\n                      <button\r\n                        onClick={() => openThread(thread)}\r\n                        className={cn(\r\n                          \"w-full text-left p-3 rounded-lg border transition-colors\",\r\n                          isSelected\r\n                            ? \"bg-amber-500/10                        <div className=\"flex items-start gap-2\">\r\n                          <div className={cn(\"rounded-md p-1.5 shrink-0\", cat.bg, cat.border, \"border\")}>\r\n                            <Icon className={cn(\"h-3.5 w-3.5\", cat.color)} />\r\n                          </div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\">\r\n                            <div {thread.unreadCount > 0 && (\r\n                                <Badge className=\"bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0\">\r\n                                  {thread.unreadCount}\r\n                                </Badge>\r\n                              )}\r\n                            </div>\r\n                            <p className={cn(\"text-xs )}\r\n                            {thread.deadlineDate && (\r\n                              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 text-[10px] text-rose-400\">\r\n </motion.div>\r\n                  );\r\n                })}\r\n              </AnimatePresence>\r\n            )}\r\n          </CardContent>\r\n        </Card>\r\n\r\n        {/* Conversation view */}\r\n        <Card className={cn(cardBg, \"lg:max-h-[80vh] lg:overflow-y-auto\")}>\r\n          {!selectedThread ? Helpers ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\nfunction fmtDateTime(s: string | null | undefined): string {\r\n  if (!s) return \"ΓÇö\";\r\n  return new Date(s).toLocaleString(\"en-PK\", {\r\n    day: \"2-digit\", month: \"short\", year: \"numeric\",\r\n    hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\",\r\n  });\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction fmtRelative(s: string | null | undefined): string {\r\n  if (!s) return \"ΓÇö\";\r\n  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(s).getTime();\r\n  const min = Math.floor(diff / 60000);\r\n  if (min < 1) return \"just now\";\r\n  if (min < 60) return `${min}m ago`;\r\n  const hr = Math.floor(min / 60);\r\n  if (hr < 24) return `${hr}h ago`;\r\n  const day = Math.floor(hr / 24);\r\n  if (day < 7) return `${day}d ago`;\r\n  return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString(\"en-PK\", { day: \"2-digit\", month: \"short\" });\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇ Main Component ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\nexport function CommunicationCenterPage() {\r\n  const { appTheme } = useValtrioxStore();\r\n  const isDark = appTheme !==   toast.error(\"Network error\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setReplying(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Stats ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const stats = useMemo(() => {\r\n    const totalUnread = </p>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\r\n          <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={fetchThreads} className=\"gap-2\">\r\n            <RefreshCw className=\"h-4 w-4\" />       break;\r\n      case 'expired':\r\n        filtered = coupons.filter((c) => c.expiresAt && Date.parse(c.expiresAt) < now);\r\n        break;\r\n      case 'inactive':\r\n        filtered = ΓöÇΓöÇ Stats // revert on error\r\n      setCoupons(prev);\r\n      toast.error(\"Failed to update coupon\");\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Modal helpers function UserGuidePage() {\r\n  const [guideData, setGuideData] = useState<GuideData>(DEFAULT_GUIDE);\r\n  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);\r\n  const [saving, setSaving] = setUserRole(u.role || null);\r\n        setIsAdmin([\"platform_owner\", \"platform_admin\", \"owner\"].includes(u.role));\r\n      }\r\n    } catch { /* ignore */ }\r\n    setInitDone(true);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Load custom guide content from API (non-blocking, background)\r\n  // SECURITY: Only use DB data if it has MORE content than DEFAULT_GUIDE\r\n  // This prevents empty/corrupt DB data from overwriting good defaults\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    let cancelled = false;\r\n    const load = async () => {\r\n      try {\r\n        const r = await fetchWithAuth(\"/api/admin/guide\");\r\n        if (!r.ok) return;\r\n        const data = await r.json();\r\n        if (cancelled) return;\r\n        if (data?.content && Array.isArray(data.content.tabs) && data.content.tabs.length > 0) {\r\n          // CRITICAL: Validate that DB content is actually good (has items)\r\n          const dbTotalItems = data.content.tabs.reduce((s: number, t: any) => s + (t.items?.length || 0), 0);\r\n          const defaultTotalItems = DEFAULT_GUIDE.tabs.reduce((s, t) => s + t.items.length, 0);\r\n          // Only use DB content if it has MORE items than defaults (admin must have added content)\r\n          if (dbTotalItems >= defaultTotalItems) {\r\n            setGuideData(data.content);\r\n          }\r\n        }\r\n      } catch { /* keep defaults */ }\r\n    };\r\n    load();\r\n    return () => { cancelled = true; };\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  // Save guide\r\n  const saveGuide = async () => {\r\n    setSaving(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      // SECURITY (Phase 17): user id comes from in-memory headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, content: guideData }),\r\n      });\r\n      if (r.ok) { toast.success(\"Guide saved\"); setEditMode(false); }\r\n      else toast.error(\"Failed to save\");\r\n    } catch { toast.error(\"Failed to save\"); }\r\n    setSaving(false);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const resetGuide = () => {\r\n    setGuideData(DEFAULT_GUIDE);\r\n    toast.success(\"Guide reset to defaults.          <RefreshCw className=\"h-3 w-3\" /> <span className=\"hidden sm:inline\">Reset</span>\r\n                </Button>\r\n                <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"outline\"      <X className=\"h-3 w-3\" /> <span className=\"hidden sm:inline\">Cancel</span>\r\n                </Button>\r\n                <Button size=\"sm\" className={cn(\"gap-1 text-xs\", accentBtn)} setBroadcasts(data.broadcasts || []);\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      // silent\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setLoading(false);\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => { fetchBroadcasts(); });\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        toast.success(\"Broadcast campaign created!\");\r\n        setCreateOpen(false);\r\n        setFormData({ name: \"\", channel: \"whatsapp\", targetAudience: };\r\n  });\r\n  const maxChannelCount = Math.max(...channelStats.map((c) => c.totalRecipients), 1);\r\n\r\n  // Best performing channel\r\n  const bestChannel = channelStats.reduce((best, cur) => <MousePointer className=\"h-3 w-3\" /> {b.clickRate.toFixed(1)}% clicks\r\n                                </span>\r\n                              </>\r\n                            )}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n\r\n                        {/* Actions */}\r\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                          <Button\r\n                            variant=\"ghost\"\r\n                            size=\"sm\"\r\n                            className=\"text-red-400 hover:text-red-300                       </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                    </motion.div>\r\n                  );\r\n                })}\r\n              </AnimatePresence>\r\n toast.success(enabled ? \"Rule enabled\" : \"Rule disabled\");\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Failed to toggle rule\");\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleDeleteRule = async (ruleId:   } catch {\r\n        // best-effort\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      await fetchAuditLog();\r\n      setConfigOpen(false);\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      toast.error(\"Network error\");\r\n    } finally ============================================================================\r\n\r\nfunction markdownToHtml(md: string): string {\r\n  if (!md || !md.trim()) return \"\";\r\n  // If content already contains HTML block-level tags, return as-is\r\n  if (/<(?:p|div|h[1-6]|br|ul|ol|li|blockquote|pre|code|strong|b|em)\\b[^>]*>/i.test(md)) {\r\n    return md;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  let html = md;\r\n\r\n  //   .replace(/\\son\\w+\\s*=\\s*[\"'][^\"']*[\"']/gi, \"\")\r\n    .replace(/\\son\\w+\\s*=\\s*\\S+/gi, \"\")\r\n    .replace(/javascript\\s*:/gi, \"\");\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction isHtmlEmpty(html: string): .replace(/&nbsp;/g, \" \")\r\n    .trim();\r\n  return text.length === 0;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Rich Text Content Styles ============================================================================\r\n// Rich Text Editor Sub-Components\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\ninterface RichTextEditorProps {\r\n  value: string;\r\n  onChange: (html: string) => void;\r\n  placeholder?: string;\r\n  isDark?: boolean;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction ToolbarButton({\r\n  label,\r\n  icon: Icon,\r\n  onClick,\r\n  isActive = false,\r\n  title,\r\n  isDark: dark,\r\n}: {\r\n  label?: string;\r\n  icon?: React.ElementType;\r\n  onClick: () => void;\r\n  isActive?: boolean;\r\n  title: string;\r\n  isDark: boolean;\r\n}) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <button\r\n      type=\"button\"\r\n      onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}\r\n      onClick={onClick}\r\n      title={title}\r\n      className={cn(\r\n        \"h-7 min-w-[28px] px-1.5 flex items-center justify-center rounded transition-colors\",\r\n        dark\r\n          ? \"hover:bg-white/[0.08] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200\"\r\n          : \"hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800\",\r\n        isActive &&\r\n          \"bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/30 hover:text-amber-300\"\r\n      )}\r\n    >\r\n      {Icon ? (\r\n        <Icon className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\r\n      ) : (\r\n        <span className=\"text-[11px] font-bold leading-none\">{label}</span>\r\n      )}\r\n    </button>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction ToolbarSep({ isDark: dark }: { isDark: boolean }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <div\r\n      className={cn(\r\n        \"w-px h-5 mx-1.5 shrink-0\",\r\n        dark ? \"bg-white/[0.08]\" : \"bg-slate-200\"\r\n      )}\r\n    />\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction RichTextEditor({\r\n  value,\r\n  onChange,\r\n  placeholder,\r\n  isDark = true,\r\n}: RichTextEditorProps) {\r\n  const editorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\r\n  const lastEmittedValue = useRef<string>(\"\");\r\n  const placeholderRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\r\n\r\n  const [activeStates, setActiveStates] = useState({\r\n    bold: false,\r\n    italic: false,\r\n    underline: false,\r\n    strikethrough: false,\r\n    formatBlock: \"p\",\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  // Sync external value into editor only when it comes from outside (not from user edits)\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (editorRef.current && value !== lastEmittedValue.current) {\r\n      editorRef.current.innerHTML = value;\r\n      lastEmittedValue.current = value;\r\n      if (placeholderRef.current) {\r\n        placeholderRef.current.style.display = isHtmlEmpty(value) ? \"\" : \"none\";\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  }, [value]);\r\n\r\n  // Track active formatting states on selection change\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    const updateStates = () => {\r\n      try {\r\n        const fb = (document.queryCommandValue(\"formatBlock\") || \"\")\r\n          .toLowerCase()\r\n          .replace(/[<>]/g, \"\");\r\n        setActiveStates({\r\n          bold: document.queryCommandState(\"bold\"),\r\n          italic: document.queryCommandState(\"italic\"),\r\n          underline: document.queryCommandState(\"underline\"),\r\n          strikethrough: document.queryCommandState(\"strikeThrough\"),\r\n          formatBlock: fb,\r\n        });\r\n      } catch {\r\n        /* ignore */\r\n      }\r\n    };\r\n    document.addEventListener(\"selectionchange\", updateStates);\r\n    return () => document.removeEventListener(\"selectionchange\", updateStates);\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const handleInput = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (!editorRef.current) return;\r\n    const html = editorRef.current.innerHTML;\r\n    const text = editorRef.current.textContent || \"\";\r\n    lastEmittedValue.current = html;\r\n    if (placeholderRef.current) {\r\n      placeholderRef.current.style.display = text.trim() ? \"none\" : \"\";\r\n    }\r\n    onChange(html);\r\n  }, [onChange]);\r\n\r\n  const handlePaste = useCallback((e: React.ClipboardEvent) => {\r\n    e.preventDefault();\r\n    const text = e.clipboardData.getData(\"text/plain\");\r\n    document.execCommand(\"insertText\", false, text);\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const handleKeyDown = useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {\r\n    if (e.key === \"Tab\") {\r\n      e.preventDefault();\r\n      document.execCommand(\"insertText\", false, \"  \");\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const exec = useCallback((command: string, val?: string) => {\r\n    document.execCommand(command, false, val);\r\n    if (editorRef.current) {\r\n      editorRef.current.dispatchEvent(\r\n        new Event(\"input\", { bubbles: true })\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const toggleFormatBlock = useCallback((tag: string) => {\r\n    const current = (\r\n      document.queryCommandValue(\"formatBlock\") || \"\"\r\n    )\r\n      .toLowerCase()\r\n      .replace(/[<>]/g, \"\");\r\n    if (current === tag.toLowerCase()) {\r\n      document.execCommand(\"formatBlock\", false, \"<p>\");\r\n    } else {\r\n      document.execCommand(\"formatBlock\", false, `<${tag}>`);\r\n    }\r\n    if (editorRef.current) {\r\n      editorRef.current.dispatchEvent(\r\n        new Event(\"input\", { bubbles: true })\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const handleLink = useCallback(() => {\r\n    const url = window.prompt(\"Enter URL:\");\r\n    if (url) {\r\n      document.execCommand(\"createLink\", false, url);\r\n      if (editorRef.current) {\r\n        editorRef.current.dispatchEvent(\r\n          new Event(\"input\", { bubbles: true })\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <div\r\n      className={cn(\r\n        \"rounded-lg border overflow-hidden\",\r\n        isDark ? \"border-white/[0.08]\" : \"border-slate-200\"\r\n      )}\r\n    >\r\n      {/* Toolbar */}\r\n      <div\r\n        className={cn(\r\n          \"flex items-center gap-0.5 px-2 py-1.5 border-b flex-wrap\",\r\n          isDark\r\n            ? \"bg-white/[0.03] border-white/[0.06]\"\r\n            : \"bg-slate-50 border-slate-200\"\r\n        )}\r\n      >\r\n        {/* Undo / Redo */}\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Undo2} onClick={() => exec(\"undo\")} title=\"Undo (Ctrl+Z)\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Redo2} onClick={() => exec(\"redo\")} title=\"Redo (Ctrl+Y)\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarSep isDark={isDark} />\r\n        {/* Text formatting */}\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Bold} onClick={() => exec(\"bold\")} isActive={activeStates.bold} title=\"Bold (Ctrl+B)\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Italic} onClick={() => exec(\"italic\")} isActive={activeStates.italic} title=\"Italic (Ctrl+I)\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Underline} onClick={() => exec(\"underline\")} isActive={activeStates.underline} title=\"Underline (Ctrl+U)\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Strikethrough} onClick={() => exec(\"strikeThrough\")} isActive={activeStates.strikethrough} title=\"Strikethrough\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarSep isDark={isDark} />\r\n        {/* Headings */}\r\n        <ToolbarButton label=\"H1\" onClick={() => toggleFormatBlock(\"h1\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"h1\"} title=\"Heading 1\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton label=\"H2\" onClick={() => toggleFormatBlock(\"h2\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"h2\"} title=\"Heading 2\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton label=\"H3\" onClick={() => toggleFormatBlock(\"h3\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"h3\"} title=\"Heading 3\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarSep isDark={isDark} />\r\n        {/* Lists */}\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={List} onClick={() => exec(\"insertUnorderedList\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"ul\"} title=\"Bullet List\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={ListOrdered} onClick={() => exec(\"insertOrderedList\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"ol\"} title=\"Numbered List\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarSep isDark={isDark} />\r\n        {/* Insert */}\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Link2} onClick={handleLink} title=\"Insert Link\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Code2} onClick={() => toggleFormatBlock(\"pre\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"pre\"} title=\"Code Block\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Quote} onClick={() => toggleFormatBlock(\"blockquote\")} isActive={activeStates.formatBlock === \"blockquote\"} title=\"Blockquote\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n        <ToolbarButton icon={Minus} onClick={() => exec(\"insertHorizontalRule\")} title=\"Horizontal Rule\" isDark={isDark} />\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Editor area */}\r\n      <div className=\"relative\">\r\n        <div\r\n          ref={placeholderRef}\r\n          className={cn(\r\n            \"absolute top-4 left-4 text-sm pointer-events-none select-none\",\r\n            isDark ? \"text-slate-500\" : \"text-slate-400\"\r\n          )}\r\n          style={{ display: isHtmlEmpty(value) ? \"\" : \"none\" }}\r\n        >\r\n          {placeholder}\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div\r\n          ref={editorRef}\r\n            \"rte-content min-h-[400px] max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto p-4 outline-none text-sm leading-relaxed\",\r\n            isDark\r\n              ? \"text-gray-200 bg-[#12121a]\"\r\n              : \"text-slate-800 bg-white\"\r\n          )}\r\n          style={{ caretColor: isDark ? \"#D4A73A\" : undefined }}\r\n        />\r\n      </div>\r\n    </div>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\n// = Math.max(0, subtotal - (Number(discountAmount) || 0));\r\n  const taxAmount = Math.round(taxableBase * (Number(taxRate) / 100) * 100) / 100;\r\n  const total = Math.round((taxableBase + taxAmount) * 100) / 100;\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Fetch invoices ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const fetchInvoices = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    setLoading(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(\"/api/admin/invoices/custom\");\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        const data = await res.json();\r\n        setInvoices(data.invoices || []);\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(\"Failed to load custom invoices\");\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Network error\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setLoading(false);\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Fetch orgs (for client picker) ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const fetchOrgs = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(\"/api/admin/clients\");\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        const data = await res.json();\r\n        const list = (data.clients || []).map((c: any) => ({\r\n          id: c.id,\r\n          name: c.name,\r\n          email: c.email,\r\n          country: null,\r\n          plan: c.plan,\r\n        }));\r\n        setOrgs(list);\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      // ignore ΓÇö admin can still type client name manually\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  /* eslint-disable react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- fetching initial data on mount */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    fetchInvoices();\r\n    fetchOrgs();\r\n  }, [fetchInvoices, fetchOrgs]);\r\n  /* eslint-enable react-hooks/set-state-in-effect */\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Form helpers ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const updateLineItem = (idx: number, field: keyof LineItem, value: string | number) => {\r\n    setLineItems((prev) => prev.map((li, i) => {\r\n      if (i !== idx) return li;\r\n      const next = { ...li, [field]: value };\r\n      if (field === \"qty\" || field === \"rate\") {\r\n        next.amount = Math.round(Number(next.qty) * Number(next.rate) * 100) / 100;\r\n      }\r\n      return next;\r\n    }));\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const addLineItem = () => {\r\n    setLineItems((prev) => [...prev, { description: \"\", qty: 1, rate: 0, amount: 0 }]);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const removeLineItem = (idx: number) => {\r\n    setLineItems((prev) => prev.length > 1 ? prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) : prev);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // When org is selected, prefill client fields\r\n  const handleOrgSelect = (orgId: string) => {\r\n    setOrgId(orgId);\r\n    const org = orgs.find((o) => o.id === orgId);\r\n    if (org) {\r\n      setClientName(org.name);\r\n      if (org.email) setClientEmail(org.email);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const resetForm = () => {\r\n    setOrgId(\"\");\r\n    setClientName(\"\");\r\n    setClientEmail(\"\");\r\n    setClientAddress(\"\");\r\n    setInvoiceTitle(\"\");\r\n    setLineItems([{ description: \"\", qty: 1, rate: 0, amount: 0 }]);\r\n    setTaxRate(0);\r\n    setDiscountAmount(0);\r\n    setNotes(\"\");\r\n    setDueDate(\"\");\r\n    setSendImmediately(false);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Create custom invoice ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const handleCreate = async () => {\r\n    if (!clientName.trim()) {\r\n      toast.error(\"Client name is required\");\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (lineItems.length === 0 || lineItems.every((li) => !li.description.trim())) {\r\n      toast.error(\"Add at least one line item with a description\");\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    const cleanItems = lineItems.filter((li) => li.description.trim());\r\n    if (cleanItems.length === 0) {\r\n      toast.error(\"Each line item needs a description\");\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    setCreating(true);\r\n    const payload = {\r\n      organizationId: orgId || undefined,\r\n      clientName: clientName.trim(),\r\n      clientEmail: clientEmail.trim() || undefined,\r\n      clientAddress: clientAddress.trim() || undefined,\r\n      invoiceTitle: invoiceTitle.trim() || undefined,\r\n      lineItems: cleanItems.map((li) => ({\r\n        description: li.description.trim(),\r\n        qty: Number(li.qty) || Number(discountAmount) || 0,\r\n      notes: notes.trim() || undefined,\r\n      dueDate: dueDate || undefined,\r\n      sendImmediately,\r\n    };\r\n\r\n    const attemptCreate = async (): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> => {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(\"/api/admin/invoices/custom\", {\r\n        method: \"POST\",\r\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify(payload),\r\n      });\r\n      // Robust error parsing ΓÇö server may return JSON or plain text\r\n      let data: any = {};\r\n      try {\r\n        const text = await res.text();\r\n        data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};\r\n      } catch {\r\n        data = { error: `Server returned status ${res.status}` };\r\n      }\r\n      if (res.ok) return { ok: true };\r\n      return { ok: false, error: data.error || `Failed to create invoice (status ${res.status})` };\r\n    };\r\n\r\n    try {\r\n      let result = await attemptCreate();\r\n\r\n      // Auto-retry once after a short delay if the server signals a schema repair\r\n      // was triggered (the server-side ensureInvoicePhase2Columns runs on every\r\n      // request, but the first cold-start request may still race).\r\n      if (!result.ok && result.error && (\r\n        result.error.toLowerCase().includes(\"schema\") ||\r\n        result.error.toLowerCase().includes(\"does not exist\") ||\r\n        result.error.toLowerCase().includes(\"column\")\r\n      )) {\r\n        toast.info(\"Database schema is being prepared. Retrying automaticallyΓÇª\", { duration: 4000 });\r\n        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));\r\n        result = await attemptCreate();\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (result.ok) {\r\n        toast.success(sendImmediately ? \"Invoice created and sent!\" : \"Invoice saved as draft\");\r\n        setCreateOpen(false);\r\n        resetForm();\r\n        await fetchInvoices();\r\n      } else {\r\n        // Log full error to console for debugging, show in toast for 15s\r\n        console.error(\"[Custom Invoice] Create failed:\", result.error);\r\n        toast.error(result.error || \"Failed to create invoice\", { duration: 15000 });\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Network error ΓÇö please check your connection and retry\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setCreating(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Send invoice (draft ΓåÆ sent) ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const handleSend = async (inv: CustomInvoice) => {\r\n    if (!inv.clientEmail) {\r\n      toast.error(\"Invoice has no client email. Edit invoice first to add one.\");\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    setActionLoading((p) => ({ ...p, [`send-${inv.id}`]: true }));\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/admin/invoices/${inv.id}/send`, {\r\n        method: \"POST\",\r\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify({ email: inv.clientEmail }),\r\n      });\r\n      const data = await res.json();\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        toast.success(`Invoice emailed to ${data.recipientEmail}`);\r\n        await fetchInvoices();\r\n      } else {\r\n        const errMsg = data.error || \"Failed to send invoice\";\r\n        console.error(\"[Invoice Send] Failed:\", errMsg);\r\n        toast.error(errMsg, { duration: 15000 });\r\n      }\r\n    } catch (e) {\r\n      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : \"Network error\";\r\n      console.error(\"[Invoice Send] Network error:\", msg);\r\n      toast.error(`Network error: ${msg}`, { duration: 15000 });\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setActionLoading((p) => ({ ...p, [`send-${inv.id}`]: false }));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Approve payment (sent/pending ΓåÆ approved, unlocks PDF) ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const handleApprove = async (inv: CustomInvoice) => {\r\n    setActionLoading((p) => ({ ...p, [`approve-${inv.id}`]: true }));\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/admin/invoices/${inv.id}/approve`, {\r\n        method: \"POST\",\r\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify({\r\n          paymentMethod: \"manual_verification\",\r\n          adminNote: \"Payment verified by admin from Custom Invoices tab\",\r\n        }),\r\n      });\r\n      const data = await res.json();\r\n      if (res.ok) {\r\n        toast.success(\"Payment verified. PDF download unlocked for client.\");\r\n        await fetchInvoices();\r\n      } else {\r\n        const errMsg = data.error || \"Failed to approve payment\";\r\n        console.error(\"[Invoice Approve] Failed:\", errMsg);\r\n        toast.error(errMsg, { duration: 15000 });\r\n      }\r\n    } catch (e) {\r\n      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : \"Network error\";\r\n      console.error(\"[Invoice Approve] Network error:\", msg);\r\n      toast.error(`Network error: ${msg}`, { duration: 15000 });\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setActionLoading((p) => ({ ...p, [`approve-${inv.id}`]: false }));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Download PDF ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const handleDownloadPdf = async (inv: CustomInvoice) => {\r\n    setActionLoading((p) => ({ ...p, [`pdf-${inv.id}`]: true }));\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/admin/invoices/${inv.id}/pdf`);\r\n      if (!res.ok) {\r\n        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));\r\n        const errMsg = data.error || \"Failed to download PDF\";\r\n        console.error(\"[Invoice PDF] Download failed:\", errMsg);\r\n        toast.error(errMsg, { duration: 15000 });\r\n        return;\r\n      }\r\n      const blob = await res.blob();\r\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\r\n      const a = document.createElement(\"a\");\r\n      a.href = url;\r\n      a.download = `${inv.invoiceNumber}.pdf`;\r\n      document.body.appendChild(a);\r\n      a.click();\r\n      document.body.removeChild(a);\r\n      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\r\n      toast.success(\"PDF downloaded\");\r\n    } catch (e) {\r\n      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : \"Network error\";\r\n      console.error(\"[Invoice PDF] Network error:\", msg);\r\n      toast.error(`Network error: ${msg}`, { duration: 15000 });\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setActionLoading((p) => ({ ...p, [`pdf-${inv.id}`]: false }));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const cardBg = isDark ? \"text-slate-900\";\r\n  const textSecondary = isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-500\";\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <div className=\"space-y-6 p-4 md:p-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto\">\r\n      {/* Header */}\r\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3\">\r\n        <div>\r\n          <h1 className={cn(\"text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight flex <Button\r\n            onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}\r\n            className=\"gap-2 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white\"\r\n          >\r\n            <Plus className=\"h-4 w-4\" />             <p className={cn(\"text-xs\", textSecondary)}>Total Custom Invoices</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <p className={cn(\"text-xl font-bold\", textPrimary)}>{invoices.length}</p>\r\n          </CardContent>\r\n        </Card>\r\n        <Card className={cardBg}>\r\n          <CardContent className=\"p-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-1\">\r\n              <Clock className=\"h-4 w-4 text-yellow-400\" />\r\n              <p className={cn(\"text-xs\", textSecondary)}>Drafts / Sent</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <p className={cn(\"text-xl       <Card className={cardBg}>\r\n          <CardContent className=\"p-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-1\">\r\n              <CheckCircle2 className=\"h-4 w-4     {invoices.filter((i) => i.status === \"approved\" || i.status === \"paid\").length}\r\n            </p>\r\n          </CardContent>\r\n        </Card>\r\n        <Card className={cardBg}>\r\n          <CardContent className=\"p-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-1\">\r\n              <DollarSign className=\"h-4 w-4 text-amber-400\" />\r\n              <p layout\r\n                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}\r\n                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}\r\n                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}\r\n                transition={{ duration: </div>\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n\r\n                        {/* Line items preview */}\r\n                        {Array.isArray(inv.lineItems) && )}\r\n                      </div>\r\n\r\n                      {/* Right: Total + actions */}\r\n                      <div className=\"lg:w-56 lg:border-l lg:border-amber-500/10 lg:pl-5 flex );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // Date range filter\r\n    if (dateRange?.from) {\r\n      const from = new Date(dateRange.from);\r\n      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\r\n      result = result.filter((inv) => };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Mark Paid handler ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const handleMarkPaid = async () => {\r\n    if (!payDialogInvoice) return;\r\n    const success = await updateInvoiceStatus(payDialogInvoice.id, number): string {\r\n  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);\r\n  const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60);\r\n  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, \"0\")}`;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {\r\n  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;\r\n  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;\r\n  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction getRoleColor(role: string, isDark: boolean): string {\r\n  if (role === \"brand_owner\" || role === \"platform_owner\" || role === \"platform_admin\" || role === \"owner\") {\r\n    return isDark ? \"text-amber-400\" : \"text-amber-600\";\r\n  }\r\n  if (role === \"brand_admin\") {\r\n    return isDark ? \"text-yellow-400\" : \"text-yellow-600\";\r\n  }\r\n  if (role === \"operations_manager\" || role === \"manager\") {\r\n    return isDark ? \"text-blue-400\" : \"text-blue-600\";\r\n  }\r\n  return isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-500\";\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction getInitials(name: string): string {\r\n  return name\r\n    .split(\" \")\r\n    .map((w) => w[0])\r\n    .join(\"\")\r\n    .toUpperCase()\r\n    .slice(0, 2);\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction getAvatarColor(name: string): string {\r\n  const colors = [\r\n    \"bg-blue-500\", \"bg-amber-500\", \"bg-yellow-500\", \"bg-rose-500\",\r\n    \"bg-amber-500\", \"bg-cyan-500\", \"bg-pink-500\", \"bg-amber-500\",\r\n  ];\r\n  let hash = 0;\r\n  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);\r\n  return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction getFileIconType(type: string): \"image\" | \"pdf\" | \"doc\" | \"file\" {\r\n  if (type.startsWith(\"image/\")) return \"image\";\r\n  if (type.includes(\"pdf\")) return \"pdf\";\r\n  if (type.includes(\"doc\") || type.includes(\"word\") || type.includes(\"text\")) return \"doc\";\r\n  return \"file\";\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Voice Note Player Component\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\nfunction VoiceNotePlayer({\r\n  voiceNote,\r\n  isDark,\r\n  isGold,\r\n}: {\r\n  voiceNote: VoiceNote;\r\n  isDark: boolean;\r\n  isGold: boolean;\r\n}) {\r\n  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);\r\n  const [playbackTime, setPlaybackTime] = useState(0);\r\n  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);\r\n  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);\r\n\r\n  const handlePlay = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (!audioRef.current) {\r\n      audioRef.current = new Audio(voiceNote.url);\r\n      audioRef.current.onended = () => {\r\n        setIsPlaying(false);\r\n        setPlaybackTime(0);\r\n        if (intervalRef.current) setIsPlaying(false);\r\n    } else {\r\n      audioRef.current.play();\r\n      setIsPlaying(true);\r\n      intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {\r\n        if (audioRef.current) {\r\n          setPlaybackTime(audioRef.current.currentTime);\r\n        }\r\n      }, 100);\r\n    }\r\n  }, [isPlaying, voiceNote.url]);\r\n\r\n  const progress = voiceNote.duration > 0 ?          {formatTime(message.timestamp)}\r\n            </span>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )}\r\n\r\n        {/* Attachment bubble */}\r\n        {message.type === \"attachment\" &&       : isDark\r\n                ? \"bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-200 rounded-tl-md\"\r\n                : \"bg-white text-slate-700 rounded-tl-md border border-slate-100 shadow-sm\"\r\n            </span>\r\n                </motion.button>\r\n              )}\r\n            </AnimatePresence>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )}\r\n      </div>\r\n    </motion.div>\r\n ============================================================================\r\n\r\nfunction VoiceRecordingBar({\r\n  isRecording,\r\n  isDark,\r\n  isGold,\r\n  onCancel,\r\n  onStop,\r\n}: {\r\n  isRecording: boolean;\r\n  isDark: boolean;\r\n  isGold: boolean;\r\n  onCancel: () => void;\r\n  onStop: (blob: Blob) => void;\r\n}) {\r\n  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | {\r\n      try {\r\n        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });\r\n        if (cancelled) {\r\n          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());\r\n          return;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        let mimeType = \"audio/webm\";\r\n        if (!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType)) {\r\n          mimeType = \"audio/ogg\";\r\n        }\r\n        if chunksRef.current = [];\r\n            return;\r\n          }\r\n          const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType || \"audio/webm\" });\r\n          if (blob.size > 0) {\r\n startTimeRef.current = Date.now();\r\n\r\n        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {\r\n          const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000);\r\n          setTime(elapsed);\r\n          if (elapsed >= MAX_VOICE_DURATION) {\r\n            if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state === \"recording\") {\r\n              mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();\r\n            }\r\n          }\r\n        }, 200);\r\n      } catch {\r\n        if (!cancelled) {\r\n          onCancel();\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n mediaRecorderRef.current.state === \"recording\") {\r\n        mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());\r\n        try { mediaRecorderRef.current.stop(); } catch {}\r\n      }\r\n      if (timerRef.current) {\r\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\r\n        timerRef.current = null;\r\n      }\r\n      chunksRef.current = [];\r\n    };\r\n  }, [isRecording,   }\r\n    if (timerRef.current) {\r\n      clearInterval(timerRef.current);\r\n      timerRef.current = null;\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const cancelRecording = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if mediaRecorderRef.current.stop(); } catch {}\r\n    }\r\n    if (timerRef.current) {\r\n      clearInterval(timerRef.current);\r\n      timerRef.current = null;\r\n    }\r\n    chunksRef.current = \"bg-red-50 border-red-200\"\r\n      }`}\r\n    >\r\n      <div className=\"relative\">\r\n        <div className=\"h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-red-500\" />\r\n        <div className=\"absolute inset-0 h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-ping opacity-40\" />\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\">\r\n        <p className={`text-xs font-medium ${isDark ? \"text-red-300\" : \"text-red-700\"}`}>\r\n          Recording Voice Note\r\n        </p>\r\n        <p className={`text-[10px] ${isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-500\"}`}>\r\n          {formatDuration(time)} / {formatDuration(MAX_VOICE_DURATION)}\r\n        </p>\r\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-px mt-1\">\r\n          {Array.from({ length: 20 }).map((_, i) => (\r\n            <motion.div\r\n              key={i}\r\n              className={`w-0.5 rounded-full ${isGold ? \"bg-amber-500/40\" : \"bg-amber-500/40\"}`}\r\n              animate={{\r\n                height: [4,
