data.message.voiceNote,\r\n        callInfo: data.message.callInfo,\r\n      };\r\n      // Optimistically add to local state\r\n      const mapKey = isAdmin ? targetConvId : (targetConvId);\r\n      setMessagesMap((prev) => {\r\n        const existing = prev[mapKey] || [];\r\n        return { ...prev, [mapKey]: [...existing, savedMsg] };\r\n      });\r\n      return savedMsg;\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      console.error(\"[SupportChat] sendMessage exception:\", err);\r\n      return null;\r\n    }\r\n  }, [isAdmin, getDirectAuthHeaders]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Delete message via API ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  const deleteMessage = useCallback(async (targetConvId: string | null, messageId: string) => {\r\n    if (!targetConvId) return;\r\n    try {\r\n      const directHeaders = getDirectAuthHeaders();\r\n      await fetchWithAuth(`/api/support-chat?messageId=${messageId}&conversationId=${targetConvId}`, {\r\n        method: \"DELETE\",\r\n        headers: directHeaders,\r\n      });\r\n      // Remove from local state and add system message\r\n      setMessagesMap((prev) => {\r\n        const existing = prev[targetConvId] || [];\r\n        const filtered = existing.filter((m) => m.id !== messageId);\r\n        const systemMsg: SupportMessage = {\r\n          id: `sys-${Date.now()}`,\r\n          senderId: \"system\",\r\n          senderName: \"System\",\r\n          senderRole: \"system\",\r\n          content: \"A message was deleted\",\r\n          timestamp: Date.now(),\r\n          type: \"system\",\r\n        };\r\n        return { ...prev, [targetConvId]: [...filtered, systemMsg] };\r\n      });\r\n    } catch {}\r\n  }, [getDirectAuthHeaders]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Initial load ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (isAdmin) {\r\n      fetchConversations();\r\n    } else if (orgId) {\r\n      fetchMessages(orgId);\r\n    }\r\n  }, [isAdmin, orgId, fetchConversations, fetchMessages]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Admin: fetch messages when selecting a client ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (isAdmin && activeClientOrgId) {\r\n      // conversationIdMap might not have the ID yet; try fetch, or refresh first\r\n      const convId = conversationIdMap[activeClientOrgId];\r\n      if (convId) {\r\n        fetchMessages(activeClientOrgId);\r\n      } else {\r\n        // Fetch conversations first to populate conversationIdMap, then fetch messages\r\n        fetchConversations().then(() => {\r\n          fetchMessages(activeClientOrgId);\r\n        });\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  }, [isAdmin, activeClientOrgId, conversationIdMap, fetchConversations, fetchMessages]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Poll for new messages every 5 seconds ΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    const interval = setInterval(() => {\r\n      if (isAdmin) {\r\n        fetchConversations();\r\n        if (activeClientOrgId && conversationIdMap[activeClientOrgId]) {\r\n          fetchMessages(activeClientOrgId);\r\n        }\r\n      } else if (orgId) {\r\n        fetchMessages(orgId);\r\n      }\r\n    }, 5000);\r\n    return () => clearInterval(interval);\r\n  }, [isAdmin, activeClientOrgId, orgId, conversationIdMap, fetchConversations, fetchMessages]);\r\n\r\n  // Filtered messages (search)\r\n  const filteredMessages = useMemo(() => {\r\n    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return currentMessages;\r\n    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();\r\n    return currentMessages.filter((m) => (m.content || \"\").toLowerCase().includes(q));\r\n  }, [currentMessages, searchQuery]);\r\n\r\n  // Create base message (uses ADMIN_ID for admin, user for client)\r\n  const createBaseMessage = useCallback((senderOrgId?: string): Omit<SupportMessage, \"id\" | \"type\" | \"content\" | \"timestamp\"> => {\r\n    if (isAdmin) {\r\n      return {\r\n        senderId: ADMIN_ID,\r\n        senderName: `${companyName} Support`,\r\n        senderRole: \"platform_admin\",\r\n      };\r\n    }\r\n    return {\r\n      senderId: user?.id || \"user-1\",\r\n      senderName: user?.name || orgName || \"You\",\r\n      senderAvatar: user?.image,\r\n      senderRole: user?.role || \"brand_owner\",\r\n    };\r\n  }, [isAdmin, user, orgName]);\r\n\r\n  // File to base64\r\n  const fileToBase64 = useCallback((file: File): Promise<string> => {\r\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\r\n      const reader = new FileReader();\r\n      reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);\r\n      reader.onerror = reject;\r\n      reader.readAsDataURL(file);\r\n    });\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  // Update client list entry (admin side) - now handled by the API via polling,\r\n  // but we also update locally for immediate feedback\r\n  const updateClientListEntry = useCallback((_clientOrgId: string, _lastMsg: string, _time: number) => {\r\n    // No-op - the conversation list is refreshed via API polling\r\n    // Kept for backward compatibility with call handlers that reference this\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  // Handle file selection\r\n  const handleFileSelect = useCallback(() => {\r\n    fileInputRef.current?.click();\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const handleFileChange = useCallback(async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {\r\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0];\r\n    if (!file) return;\r\n    if (file.size > MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE) {\r\n      alert(`File too large. Maximum size is ${formatFileSize(MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE)}.`);\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    setPendingAttachment(file);\r\n    if (file.type.startsWith(\"image/\")) {\r\n      const preview = URL.createObjectURL(file);\r\n      setAttachmentPreview(preview);\r\n    } else {\r\n      setAttachmentPreview(undefined);\r\n    }\r\n    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = \"\";\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const removeAttachment = useCallback(() => {\r\n    setPendingAttachment(null);\r\n    setAttachmentPreview(undefined);\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  // Get the target orgId for sending messages\r\n  const getTargetOrgId = useCallback((): string | null => {\r\n    if (isAdmin) {\r\n      return activeClientOrgId;\r\n    }\r\n    return orgId;\r\n  }, [isAdmin, activeClientOrgId, orgId]);\r\n\r\n  // Send text/attachment message\r\n  const handleSend = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    const targetId = getTargetOrgId();\r\n    if (!targetId) return;\r\n\r\n    const hasText = messageInput.trim().length > 0;\r\n    const hasAttachment = pendingAttachment !== null;\r\n\r\n    if (!hasText && !hasAttachment) return;\r\n\r\n    const base = createBaseMessage(targetId);\r\n\r\n    // Get the DB conversation ID for admin\r\n    const dbConvId = isAdmin ? conversationIdMap[targetId] : targetId;\r\n\r\n    if (hasAttachment) {\r\n      try {\r\n        const url = await fileToBase64(pendingAttachment);\r\n        const attachment: ChatAttachment = {\r\n          id: generateId(),\r\n          name: pendingAttachment.name,\r\n          type: pendingAttachment.type,\r\n          size: pendingAttachment.size,\r\n          url,\r\n        };\r\n        const msg: SupportMessage = {\r\n          ...base,\r\n          id: generateId(),\r\n          content: messageInput.trim(),\r\n          timestamp: Date.now(),\r\n          type: \"attachment\",\r\n          attachment,\r\n        };\r\n        const result = await sendMessage(dbConvId, msg, isAdmin ? undefined : orgName);\r\n        if (result) {\r\n          setPendingAttachment(null);\r\n          setAttachmentPreview(undefined);\r\n          setMessageInput(\"\");\r\n        } else {\r\n          toast.error(\"Failed to send message. Please try again.\");\r\n        }\r\n      } catch {\r\n        toast.error(\"Failed to process attachment. Please try again.\");\r\n      }\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (hasText) {\r\n      const msg: SupportMessage = {\r\n        ...base,\r\n        id: generateId(),\r\n        content: messageInput.trim(),\r\n        timestamp: Date.now(),\r\n        type: \"text\",\r\n      };\r\n      const result = await sendMessage(dbConvId, msg, isAdmin ? undefined : orgName);\r\n      if (result) {\r\n        setMessageInput(\"\");\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(\"Failed to send message. Please try again.\");\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  }, [messageInput, pendingAttachment, createBaseMessage, sendMessage, fileToBase64, getTargetOrgId, isAdmin, conversationIdMap, orgName]);\r\n\r\n  // Handle voice note stop\r\n  const handleVoiceStop = useCallback(async (blob: Blob) => {\r\n    const targetId = getTargetOrgId();\r\n    if (!targetId) {\r\n      setIsRecording(false);\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const dbConvId = isAdmin ? conversationIdMap[targetId] : targetId;\r\n\r\n    const url = await fileToBase64(blob);\r\n    const base = createBaseMessage(targetId);\r\n\r\n    // Get duration from audio metadata\r\n    const getDuration = (): Promise<number> => {\r\n      return new Promise((resolve) => {\r\n        const tempAudio = new Audio(url);\r\n        tempAudio.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(tempAudio.duration || 0);\r\n        tempAudio.onerror = () => resolve(0);\r\n        setTimeout(() => resolve(0), 3000); // Fallback timeout\r\n      });\r\n    };\r\n\r\n    const dur = await getDuration();\r\n    const msg: SupportMessage = {\r\n      ...base,\r\n      id: generateId(),\r\n      content: \"\",\r\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\r\n      type: \"voice\",\r\n      voiceNote: {\r\n        id: generateId(),\r\n        url,\r\n        duration: dur,\r\n      },\r\n    };\r\n\r\n    await sendMessage(dbConvId, msg);\r\n    setIsRecording(false);\r\n  }, [createBaseMessage, sendMessage, fileToBase64, getTargetOrgId, isAdmin, conversationIdMap]);\r\n\r\n  // Delete a message\r\n  const handleDeleteMessage = useCallback((messageId: string) => {\r\n    const targetId = getTargetOrgId();\r\n    if (!targetId) return;\r\n\r\n    const dbConvId = isAdmin ? conversationIdMap[targetId] : targetId;\r\n    deleteMessage(dbConvId, messageId);\r\n  }, [deleteMessage, getTargetOrgId, isAdmin, conversationIdMap]);\r\n\r\n  // Call handlers\r\n  const handleStartCall = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (isAdmin && activeClientOrgId) {\r\n      const client = clientList.find((c) => c.orgId === activeClientOrgId);\r\n      setCallTarget(client?.orgName || \"Client\");\r\n    } else {\r\n      setCallTarget(`${companyName} Support`);\r\n    }\r\n    setCallActive(true);\r\n  }, [isAdmin, activeClientOrgId, clientList]);\r\n\r\n  const handleEndCall = useCallback((duration: number) => {\r\n    const targetId = getTargetOrgId();\r\n    if (targetId && duration > 0) {\r\n      const dbConvId = isAdmin ? conversationIdMap[targetId] : targetId;\r\n      const callMsg: SupportMessage = {\r\n        id: generateId(),\r\n        senderId: \"system\",\r\n        senderName: \"System\",\r\n        senderRole: \"system\",\r\n        content: `Voice call ended \\u2014 duration: ${formatDuration(duration)}`,\r\n        timestamp: Date.now(),\r\n        type: \"call\",\r\n        callInfo: { duration, type: \"outgoing\" },\r\n      };\r\n      sendMessage(dbConvId, callMsg);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    setCallActive(false);\r\n  }, [getTargetOrgId, sendMessage, isAdmin, callTarget, conversationIdMap]);\r\n\r\n  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(\r\n    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {\r\n      if (e.key === \"Enter\" && !e.shiftKey) {\r\n        e.preventDefault();\r\n        handleSend();\r\n      }\r\n    },\r\n    [handleSend]\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  // Group messages by sender for display\r\n  const groupedMessages = useMemo(() => {\r\n    const senderId = isAdmin ? ADMIN_ID : (user?.id || \"user-1\");\r\n    const groups: Array<{ message: SupportMessage; isLastInGroup: boolean; isOwn: boolean }> = [];\r\n    for (let i = 0; i < filteredMessages.length; i++) {\r\n      const msg = filteredMessages[i];\r\n      const prev = filteredMessages[i - 1];\r\n      const isOwn = msg.senderId === senderId;\r\n      const sameSender = prev && prev.senderId === msg.senderId && (msg.timestamp - prev.timestamp) < 120000;\r\n      groups.push({\r\n        message: msg,\r\n        isLastInGroup: !sameSender,\r\n        isOwn,\r\n      });\r\n    }\r\n    return groups;\r\n  }, [filteredMessages, isAdmin, user?.id]);\r\n\r\n  // Determine chat header name\r\n  const chatPartnerName = isAdmin\r\n    ? (clientList.find((c) => c.orgId === activeClientOrgId)?.orgName || \"Select a client\")\r\n    : `${companyName} Support`;\r\n\r\n  // Sort client list by last message time\r\n  const sortedClientList = useMemo(() => {\r\n    return [...clientList].sort((a, b) => (b.lastMessageTime || 0) - (a.lastMessageTime || 0));\r\n  }, [clientList]);\r\n\r\n  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n  // Render: Admin View\r\n  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n  if (isAdmin) {\r\n    return (\r\n      <>\r\n        <div className={`h-[calc(100vh-8rem)] sm:h-[calc(100vh-6rem)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border ${isDark ? \"bg-white/[0.02] border-white/[0.06]\" : \"bg-white border-slate-200\"}`}>\r\n          {/* Hidden file input */}\r\n          <input\r\n            ref={fileInputRef}\r\n            type=\"file\"\r\n            className=\"hidden\"\r\n            accept=\"image/*,.pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.txt,.csv\"\r\n            onChange={handleFileChange}\r\n          />\r\n\r\n          {/* Client List Sidebar */}\r\n          <div\r\n            className={`w-full sm:w-64 lg:w-72 shrink-0 flex flex-col border-r ${\r\n              isDark ? \"border-white/[0.06]\" : \"border-slate-200\"\r\n            } ${mobileShowChat ? \"hidden sm:flex\" : \"flex\"}`}\r\n          >\r\n            {/* Admin header */}\r\n            <div className={`px-4 py-3 border-b ${isDark ? \"border-white/[0.06]\" : \"border-slate-200\"}`}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\r\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                  <Shield className={`h-5 w-5 ${accentClass}`} />\r\n                  <h2 className={`text-sm sm:text-base font-bold ${isDark ? \"text-white\" : \"text-slate-900\"}`}>\r\n                    Admin Support\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                </div>\r\n                <Badge variant=\"secondary\" className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 ${accentBg} ${accentClass}`}>\r\n                  <Shield className=\"h-2.5 w-2.5 mr-0.5\" />\r\n                  Admin\r\n                </Badge>\r\n              </div>\r\n              <p className={`text-[10px] mt-1.5 ${isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-400\"}`}>\r\n                Manage client support conversations\r\n              </p>\r\n            </div>\r\n\r\n            {/* Search clients */}\r\n            <div className={`px-3 py-2 border-b ${isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-400\"}`} />\r\n                <input\r\n                  type=\"text\"\r\n                  placeholder=\"Search clients...\"\r\n                  value={searchQuery}\r\n                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}\r\n                  className={`bg-transparent text-xs outline-none w-full ${isDark ? ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\nexport function TasksPage() {\r\n  const { organization, appTheme } = useValtrioxStore();\r\n  const isGold = appTheme === \"premium-dark\";\r\n  const isDark = appTheme === \"dark\" || isGold;\r\n\r\n  // State\r\n  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);\r\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\r\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\r\n  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>(\"board\");\r\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState(\"\");\r\n  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState(\"\");\r\n\r\n  const [taskModalOpen, setTaskModalOpen] = useState(false);\r\n  const [editingTask, setEditingTask] = useState<Task | null>(null);\r\n  const [deletingTaskId, setDeletingTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);\r\n  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);\r\n  const [statusUpdating, setStatusUpdating] = useState(false);\r\n  const [activeDragId, setActiveDragId] = useState<string | null>(null);\r\n\r\n  const ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const fetchTasks = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    if (!organization?.id) { setLoading(false); return; }\r\n\r\n    setLoading(true);\r\n    setError(null);\r\n\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/tasks?orgId=${organization.id}`);\r\n      if (!res.ok) {\r\n        const data = await res.json();\r\n        throw new Error(data.error || \"Failed to fetch tasks\");\r\n      }\r\n      const data = await res.json();\r\n      setTasks(data.tasks || []);\r\n    } catch (err: any) {\r\n      console.error(\"Fetch tasks error:\", err);\r\n      setError(err.message || \"Something went wrong\");\r\n      toast.error(\"Failed to load tasks\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setLoading(false);\r\n    }\r\n  }, [organization?.id]);\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => { fetchTasks(); }, [fetchTasks]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Debounced Search ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const handleSearchChange = (value: string) => {\r\n    setSearchInput(value);\r\n    if (searchTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimeoutRef.current);\r\n    searchTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => { setSearch(value); }, 300);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Filtered Tasks ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {\r\n    if (!search.trim()) return tasks;\r\n    const q = search.toLowerCase();\r\n    return tasks.filter((t) =>\r\n      (t.title || \"\").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\r\n      (t.description || \"\").toLowerCase().includes(q)\r\n    );\r\n  }, [tasks, search]);\r\n\r\n  const tasksByStatus = useMemo(() => {\r\n    const grouped: Record<TaskStatus, Task[]> = { todo: [], in_progress: [], done: [] };\r\n    filteredTasks.forEach((t) => {\r\n      const status = (t.status as TaskStatus) || \"todo\";\r\n      if (grouped[status]) grouped[status].push(t);\r\n    });\r\n    return grouped;\r\n  }, [filteredTasks]);\r\n\r\n  const stats = useMemo(() => ({\r\n    total: tasks.length,\r\n    todo: tasks.filter((t) => t.status === \"todo\").length,\r\n    inProgress: tasks.filter((t) => t.status === \"in_progress\").length,\r\n    done: tasks.filter((t) => t.status === \"done\").length,\r\n  }), [tasks]);\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ DnD ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const sensors = useSensors(\r\n    useSensor(PointerSensor, { activationConstraint: { distance: 8 } })\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  const handleDragStart = (event: DragStartEvent) => {\r\n    setActiveDragId(String(event.active.id));\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleDragEnd = async (event: DragEndEvent) => {\r\n    setActiveDragId(null);\r\n    const { active, over } = event;\r\n    if (!over) return;\r\n\r\n    const taskId = String(active.id);\r\n    const newStatus = String(over.id) as TaskStatus;\r\n    if (!statusColumns.some((c) => c.id === newStatus)) return;\r\n\r\n    const task = tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);\r\n    if (!task || task.status === newStatus) return;\r\n\r\n    // Optimistic update\r\n    setTasks((prev) => prev.map((t) => t.id === taskId ? { ...t, status: newStatus } : t));\r\n\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/tasks/${taskId}`, {\r\n        method: \"PATCH\",\r\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus }),\r\n      });\r\n      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(\"Failed to update status\");\r\n      toast.success(\"Task status updated\");\r\n    } catch {\r\n      // Revert\r\n      setTasks((prev) => prev.map((t) => t.id === taskId ? { ...t, status: task.status } : t));\r\n      toast.error(\"Failed to update task status\");\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Delete Task ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const handleDelete = async () => {\r\n    if (!deletingTaskId) return;\r\n    setDeleting(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/tasks/${deletingTaskId}`, { method: \"DELETE\" });\r\n      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(\"Failed to delete\");\r\n      toast.success(\"Task deleted\");\r\n      setDeletingTaskId(null);\r\n      fetchTasks();\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(\"Failed to delete task\");\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setDeleting(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Helpers ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const openEdit = (task: Task) => {\r\n    setEditingTask(task);\r\n    setTaskModalOpen(true);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const openCreate = (defaultStatus?: string) => {\r\n    setEditingTask(null);\r\n    setTaskModalOpen(true);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleModalClose = (open: boolean) => {\r\n    setTaskModalOpen(open);\r\n    if (!open) setEditingTask(null);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const formatDueDate = (date: string | null) => {\r\n    if (!date) return null;\r\n    const d = new Date(date);\r\n    const now = new Date();\r\n    const isOverdue = d < now && d.toDateString() !== now.toDateString();\r\n    const formatted = d.toLocaleDateString(\"en-PK\", { day: \"2-digit\", month: \"short\" });\r\n    return { formatted, isOverdue };\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Theme Classes ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const cardClass = isGold\r\n    ? \"bg-white/[0.03] border-white/[0.06]\"\r\n    : isDark\r\n      ? \"bg-white/[0.03] border-white/[0.06]\"\r\n      : \"bg-white\";\r\n\r\n  const textPrimary = isDark ? \"text-white\" : \"text-slate-900\";\r\n  const textSecondary = isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-slate-500\";\r\n  const textMuted = isDark ? \"text-slate-400\" : \"text-muted-foreground\";\r\n  const borderColor = isGold ? \"border-white/[0.06]\" : isDark ? \"border-white/[0.06]\" : \"border-slate-200\";\r\n\r\n  const getColumnCardBg = (colId: TaskStatus) => {\r\n    if (isGold) return \"bg-white/[0.02] ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n  const     : isDark\r\n                      ? \"bg-amber-600/20 text-amber-400\"\r\n                      : \"bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm\"\r\n                  : isDark\r\n                    ? </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Loading */}\r\n      {loading && <LoadingSkeleton />}\r\n\r\n      {/* Error */}\r\n      {!loading && error && (\r\n        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}           </CardContent>\r\n          </Card>\r\n        </motion.div>\r\n      )}\r\n\r\n      {/* ΓöÇΓöÇ Board View (Kanban) <DndContext sensors={sensors} collisionDetection={closestCorners} onDragStart={handleDragStart} onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}>\r\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 httpOnly cookies ΓÇö\r\n * see Phase 17 PII purge). Falls back to plain fetch on the server.\r\n * Throws on non-2xx responses with the error message from the server.\r\n */\r\n\r\nfunction authAwareFetch(input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {\r\n  // fetchWithAuth handles SSR gracefully (returns plain fetch on server)\r\n  return fetchWithAuth(input, init);\r\n}\r\n\r\nasync function apiFetch<T>(\r\n  url: string,\r\n  options?: RequestInit\r\n): Promise<T> {\r\n  const response = await authAwareFetch(url, {\r\n    headers: {\r\n      \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\r\n      ...options?.headers,\r\n    },\r\n    ...options,\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  if (!response.ok) {\r\n    let errorMessage = `Request failed with status ${response.status}`;\r\n    try {\r\n      const errorBody = await response.json();\r\n      if (errorBody?.error) errorMessage = errorBody.error;\r\n      if (errorBody?.details) errorMessage += `: ${errorBody.details}`;\r\n    } catch {\r\n      // Response body is not JSON - use the default error message\r\n    }\r\n    throw new Error(errorMessage);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return response.json() as Promise<T>;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Query Hooks - Orders\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Fetches a paginated list of orders for an organization.\r\n *\r\n * @example\r\n * ```tsx\r\n * const { data, isLoading } = useOrders(\"org-123\", { status: \"pending\", page: 1 });\r\n * console.log(data?.orders, data?.stats);\r\n * ```\r\n */\r\nexport function useOrders(\r\n  orgId: string | undefined | null,\r\n  params?: Omit<OrdersParams, \"orgId\">,\r\n  options?: Partial<UseQueryOptions<OrdersResponse>>\r\n) {\r\n  return useQuery({\r\n    queryKey: queryKeys.orders(orgId ?? ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\nlet process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME || process.env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME;\r\n  const apiKey = process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY;\r\n  const apiSecret = `${parsed.apiKey.slice(0, 4)}${\"ΓÇó\".repeat(Math.min(parsed.apiKey.length - 4, 12))}` : undefined,\r\n        apiSecretMasked: parsed.apiSecret ? `${\"ΓÇó\".repeat(Math.min(parsed.apiSecret.length, 16))}` : undefined,\r\n        source: \"database\",\r\n      };\r\n    }\r\n  } catch {\r\n    // Ignore\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const envCloud = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME || process.env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME;\r\n  if (envCloud) {\r\n    return {\r\n      available: true,\r\n      cloudName: envCloud,\r\n      apiKeyMasked: process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY ? logger.error(\"[Cloudinary] Upload failed\", err);\r\n    return { success: false, error: err?.message || \"Upload failed\" };\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Upload a base64 data URL to Cloudinary.\r\n * Useful when the client sends base64-encoded images.\r\n */\r\nexport async function uploadBase64(\r\n  orgId: string,\r\n  bucket: CloudinaryBucket,\r\n  base64DataUrl: string,\r\n  fileName?: string,\r\n  options?: { transformation?: object; publicId?: string }\r\n): Promise<UploadResult> {\r\n  const configured = await ensureConfigured();\r\n  if (!configured) {\r\n    return { success: false, error: \"Cloudinary is not configured\" };\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Extract MIME type and data from data URL\r\n  const matches = base64DataUrl.match(/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.+)$/);\r\n  if (!matches) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Delete a file from Cloudinary by public ID.\r\n */\r\nexport async function deleteFile(publicId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {\r\n  const configured = await ensureConfigured();\r\n  if (!configured) {\r\n    return { success: false, error: \"Cloudinary is not configured\" };\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  try {\r\n    const result: DeleteApiResponse = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\r\n      cloudinary.uploader.destroy(publicId, (error, result) => {\r\n        if (error) reject(error);\r\n        else resolve(result);\r\n      });\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    if (result.result === \"ok\" || result.result === \"not found\") {\r\n      return { success: true };\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    return { success: false, error: `Delete failed: ${result.result}` };\r\n  } in an org's specific bucket folder.\r\n */\r\nexport async function deleteOrgFolder(orgId: string, bucket: CloudinaryBucket): Promise<{ deleted: number; error?: string }> {\r\n  const configured = await ensureConfigured();\r\n  if (!configured) {\r\n    return { deleted: 0, error: \"Cloudinary is not configured\" };\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  try {\r\n    const prefix = `${getOrgFolder(orgId)}/${bucket}/`;\r\n\r\n    // List all resources with prefix\r\n    const resources = await new Promise<ResourceApiResponse>((resolve, reject) => {\r\n      cloudinary.api.resources_by_prefix(prefix, {\r\n        type: \"upload\",\r\n        max_results: 500,\r\n      }, (error, result) => {\r\n        if (error) reject(error);\r\n        else cloudinary.api.delete_resources(publicIds, (error, result) => {\r\n        if (error) reject(error);\r\n        else resolve(result);\r\n      });\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    return { deleted: }\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Usage Tracking ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Get storage usage for a specific organization from Cloudinary.\r\n * Lists all resources under the org folder and sums their sizes.\r\n */\r\nexport async function getOrgCloudinaryUsage(orgId: string): Promise<CloudinaryUsageInfo> {\r\n  const configured = await ensureConfigured();\r\n  if (!configured) {\r\n    return { totalFiles: 0, totalBytes: 0, totalMb: 0, breakdown: {} };\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const prefix = getOrgFolder(orgId);\r\n  let totalFiles = 0;\r\n  let totalBytes = 0;\r\n  const breakdown: Record<string, { files: number; bytes: number }> = {};\r\n\r\n  // Initialize breakdown for all buckets\r\n  for (const bucket of Object.values(CLOUDINARY_BUCKETS)) {\r\n    breakdown[bucket] = { files: 0, bytes: 0 };\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  try {\r\n    // Paginate through all resources (max 500 per request)\r\n    let nextCursor: string | undefined;\r\n    let fetchedAll = false;\r\n\r\n    while (!fetchedAll) {\r\n      const resources = await new Promise<ResourceApiResponse>((resolve, reject) => {\r\n        const params: any = {\r\n          type: \"upload\",\r\n          prefix,\r\n          max_results: 500,\r\n          direction: \"desc\",\r\n        };\r\n        if (nextCursor) params.next_cursor = nextCursor;\r\n\r\n        cloudinary.api.resources(params, (error, result) => {\r\n          if (error) reject(error);\r\n          else resolve(result as ResourceApiResponse);\r\n        });\r\n      });\r\n\r\n      if (!resources.resources || resources.resources.length === 0) {\r\n        fetchedAll = true;\r\n        break;\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      for (const resource of resources.resources) {\r\n        const bytes = resource.bytes || 0;\r\n        totalFiles++;\r\n        totalBytes += bytes;\r\n\r\n        // Determine which bucket this belongs to\r\n        for (const bucketName of Object.values(CLOUDINARY_BUCKETS)) {\r\n          if (resource.public_id.includes(`/${bucketName}/`)) {\r\n            breakdown[bucketName].files++;\r\n            breakdown[bucketName].bytes += bytes;\r\n            break;\r\n          }\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      // Check for more pages\r\n      if (resources.next_cursor) {\r\n        nextCursor = resources.next_cursor;\r\n      } else {\r\n        fetchedAll = true;\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  } catch (err: any) {\r\n    logger.warn(\"[Cloudinary] Usage fetch failed\", { error: ORDER_TABLES_SQL,\r\n  REMAINING_TABLES_SQL,\r\n  NEW_TABLES_SQL,\r\n];\r\n\r\nconst DDL_BATCH_NAMES = [\r\n  'Core auth tables',\r\n  'Business tables',\r\n  'Operations tables',\r\n  'Subscription & Payment tables',\r\n  'Order tables',\r\n  'Remaining tables',\r\n  'New tables (PlatformDocument, IntegrationConnection, Feedback, BetaInvite)',\r\n];\r\n\r\n// ΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉ\r\n// ΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉ\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Classify a connection error into a human-friendly message.\r\n */\r\nfunction classifyConnectionError(err: unknown): string {\r\n  const { message, code } = getErrorInfo(err);\r\n  const msg = message.toLowerCase();\r\n\r\n  if (msg.includes('enotfound') || msg.includes('getaddrinfo')) {\r\n    return 'Host not found - check that the database URL is correct';\r\n  }\r\n  if (msg.includes('econnrefused')) {\r\n    return 'Connection refused - the database host/port may be wrong or the DB is not accepting connections';\r\n  }\r\n  if (msg.includes('etimedout') || msg.includes('timeout')) {\r\n    return 'Connection timed out - the database might be paused, or network/firewall is blocking the connection';\r\n  }\r\n  if (msg.includes('authentication') || msg.includes('password') || code === '28P01') {\r\n    return 'Authentication failed - check the database password in DATABASE_URL';\r\n  }\r\n  if (msg.includes('ssl') || msg.includes('certificate')) {\r\n    return 'SSL error - the database requires SSL but the connection could not negotiate it';\r\n  }\r\n  if (msg.includes('too many connections') || code === '53300') {\r\n    return 'Too many connections - the database connection pool is exhausted';\r\n  }\r\n  if (msg.includes('ddl') || msg.includes('pgbouncer') || msg.includes('prepared statement')) {\r\n    return 'DDL blocked by PgBouncer - direct connection is required for CREATE TABLE';\r\n  }\r\n  return msg || String(err);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Try creating tables using a single connection config.\r\n * Runs DDL in sequential batches to avoid Vercel serverless function timeouts.\r\n */\r\nasync function tryCreateWithConfig(config: PoolConfig, label: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error: string | null }> {\r\n  const pool = new Pool(config);\r\n  try {\r\n    logger.info('[DB] Attempting table creation', { method: label });\r\n\r\n    // Test connection first\r\n    await pool.query('SELECT 1 as ok');\r\n    logger.info('[DB] Connection test PASSED', { method: label });\r\n\r\n    // Execute DDL in batches to avoid timeout on Vercel serverless functions\r\n    for (let i = 0; i < DDL_BATCHES.length; i++) {\r\n      if (!DDL_BATCHES[i]) continue; // Skip empty batches\r\n      const batchName = DDL_BATCH_NAMES[i] || `Batch ${i + 1}`;\r\n      logger.info('[DB] Running DDL batch', { batch: i + 1, total: DDL_BATCHES.length, name: batchName, method: label });\r\n      const startTime = Date.now();\r\n      await pool.query(DDL_BATCHES[i]);\r\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\r\n      logger.info('[DB] DDL batch completed', { batch: i + 1, total: DDL_BATCHES.length, name: batchName, elapsed, method: label });\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    logger.info('[DB] All batches completed', { total: DDL_BATCHES.length, method: label });\r\n    return { success: true, error: null };\r\n  } catch (err: unknown) {\r\n    const { message: errMsg, code: errCode } = getErrorInfo(err);\r\n    const friendly = classifyConnectionError(err);\r\n    logger.error(`[DB] ${label} FAILED`, { friendly });\r\n    logger.error('[DB] Raw error', { errMsg, errCode });\r\n    return { success: false, error: friendly };\r\n  } finally {\r\n    try { await pool.end(); } catch {}\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * createAllTables - Creates all 27 database tables.\r\n * Tries multiple connection strategies in order:\r\n *   1. DIRECT_URL env var (if set)\r\n *   2. Auto-converted direct URL (from DATABASE_URL pooler format)\r\n *   3. DATABASE_URL as-is (might work if it's already direct)\r\n */\r\nexport async function createAllTables(): Promise<boolean> {\r\n  if (schemaCreated) return true;\r\n\r\n  const configs = getDdlConnectionConfigs();\r\n  logger.info('[DB] createAllTables: trying connection methods', { count: configs.length });\r\n  // FIX 4.9: Use non-logging check ΓÇö avoid any env var reference in logs\r\n  const hasDbUrl = !!process.env.DATABASE_URL;\r\n  const hasDirectUrl = !!process.env.DIRECT_URL;\r\n  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== \"production\") {\r\n    logger.info('[DB] DATABASE_URL set', { hasDbUrl });\r\n    logger.info('[DB] DIRECT_URL set', { hasDirectUrl });\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  if (configs.length === 0) {\r\n    createError = 'No database URL configured. Set DATABASE_URL in Vercel environment variables.';\r\n    lastCreateDetail = createError;\r\n    logger.error('[DB] Configuration error', createError);\r\n    return false;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  for (let i = 0; i < configs.length; i++) {\r\n    const labels = [\r\n      'DIRECT_URL env var',\r\n      'Auto-converted direct URL',\r\n      'DATABASE_URL as-is',\r\n    ];\r\n    const result = await tryCreateWithConfig(configs[i], labels[i] || `Method ${i + 1}`);\r\n    if (result.success) {\r\n      schemaCreated = true;\r\n      createError = null;\r\n      lastCreateDetail = `Created via: ${labels[i]}`;\r\n      return true;\r\n    }\r\n    // Save the last error for debugging\r\n    createError = result.error;\r\n    lastCreateDetail = `${labels[i]} failed: ${result.error}`;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  logger.error('[DB] ALL connection methods failed');\r\n  logger.error('[DB] Last error', createError);\r\n  return false;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Get the last creation error (for debugging).\r\n */\r\nexport function getCreateError(): string | null {\r\n  return createError;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport function getLastCreateDetail(): string | null {\r\n  return lastCreateDetail;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Reset the schema created flag (for retry).\r\n */\r\nexport function resetSchemaFlag(): void {\r\n  schemaCreated = false;\r\n  createError = null;\r\n  lastCreateDetail = null;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉ\r\n//  DIRECT PG POOL - For API routes that need reliable queries\r\n//  Bypasses PgBouncer entirely so SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE always work.\r\n// ΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉ\r\n\r\nconst directPoolCache: { pool: Pool | null; url: string | null } = { pool: null, url: null };\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Returns a `pg.Pool` connected DIRECTLY to the database (port 5432),\r\n * bypassing PgBouncer. This ensures SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE always work\r\n * without PgBouncer's transaction-mode limitations.\r\n *\r\n * Uses individual params (not connectionString) to avoid SSL conflicts.\r\n *\r\n * Tries (in order):\r\n *   1. DIRECT_URL env var (if set)\r\n *   2. Auto-converted direct URL from DATABASE_URL\r\n *   3. DATABASE_URL as-is (fallback)\r\n */\r\nexport function getDirectPool(): Pool {\r\n  const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL || '';\r\n  if (!url) {\r\n    throw new Error('DATABASE_URL not configured');\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Build the best possible direct connection URL\r\n  let bestUrl: string | null = null;\r\n\r\n  // 1. DIRECT_URL env var ΓÇö BUT only if it doesn't point to the deprecated\r\n  //    db.{ref}.supabase.co direct host. Supabase has deprecated direct\r\n  //    external connections from Vercel/lambda ΓÇö the DNS no longer resolves\r\n  //    in many regions (returns ENOTFOUND). If DIRECT_URL points there, skip\r\n  //    it and fall through to the auto-converted session-mode pooler URL.\r\n  if (process.env.DIRECT_URL) {\r\n    const directParsed = parsePgUrl(process.env.DIRECT_URL);\r\n    if (directParsed && directParsed.host.startsWith('db.') && directParsed.host.endsWith('.supabase.co')) {\r\n      // Deprecated direct host ΓÇö skip and use session-mode pooler instead\r\n      logger.warn('[DB] getDirectPool: DIRECT_URL points to deprecated db.*.supabase.co host ΓÇö skipping in favor of session-mode pooler', {\r\n        host: directParsed.host,\r\n      });\r\n    } else {\r\n      bestUrl = process.env.DIRECT_URL;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 2. Auto-convert DATABASE_URL to direct (now: session-mode pooler)\r\n  if (!bestUrl) {\r\n    bestUrl = toDirectUrl(url);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 3. Fallback: use DATABASE_URL as-is (remove pgbouncer param)\r\n  if (!bestUrl) {\r\n    bestUrl = url.replace(/[?&]pgbouncer=true/gi, '').replace(/[?&]$/, '');\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 4. Final safety net: if the resolved bestUrl STILL points to db.*.supabase.co\r\n  //    (e.g. toDirectUrl fallback path), swap to the pooler URL from DATABASE_URL.\r\n  //    This guarantees we never try to connect to a host that returns ENOTFOUND.\r\n  if (bestUrl) {\r\n    const finalParsed = parsePgUrl(bestUrl);\r\n    if (finalParsed && finalParsed.host.startsWith('db.') && finalParsed.host.endsWith('.supabase.co')) {\r\n      const dbUrlParsed = parsePgUrl(url);\r\n      if (dbUrlParsed && dbUrlParsed.host.includes('.pooler.supabase.com')) {\r\n        // Use session-mode pooler: same hostname, port 5432\r\n        bestUrl = `postgresql://${encodeURIComponent(dbUrlParsed.username)}:${encodeURIComponent(dbUrlParsed.password)}@${dbUrlParsed.host}:5432/${dbUrlParsed.database}`;\r\n        logger.warn('[DB] getDirectPool: bestUrl was deprecated db.* host ΓÇö replaced with session-mode pooler', {\r\n          poolerHost: dbUrlParsed.host,\r\n        });\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Reuse pool if the URL hasn't changed\r\n  if (directPoolCache.pool && directPoolCache.url === bestUrl) {\r\n    return directPoolCache.pool;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Clean up old pool\r\n  if (directPoolCache.pool) {\r\n    directPoolCache.pool.end().catch(() => {});\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Parse URL into individual params to avoid SSL conflicts\r\n  const parsed = parsePgUrl(bestUrl!);\r\n  if (!parsed) {\r\n    throw new Error('getDirectPool: failed to parse connection URL');\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const pool = new Pool({\r\n    host: parsed.host,\r\n    port: parseInt(parsed.port) || 5432,\r\n    database: parsed.database,\r\n    user: parsed.username,\r\n    password: parsed.password,\r\n    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },\r\n    max: 3,\r\n    connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000,\r\n    idleTimeoutMillis: 5000,\r\n    statement_timeout: 8000,\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  directPoolCache.pool = pool;\r\n  directPoolCache.url = bestUrl;\r\n\r\n  logger.info('[DB] getDirectPool: using direct connection');\r\n  return pool;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉ\r\n//  Resilient direct query ΓÇö falls back to PgBouncer pool on ENOTFOUND/DNS err\r\n// ΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉΓòÉ\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Run a SQL query on the direct pool, but if the direct pool fails with a\r\n * DNS / connection error (ENOTFOUND, ECONNREFUSED, ECONNRESET), retry the\r\n * same query through Prisma's normal pool (PgBouncer transaction mode).\r\n *\r\n * Use this for one-off DDL/INSERT/UPDATE statements that need the direct\r\n * pool's session-mode capabilities but might be deployed to an environment\r\n * where the direct host isn't reachable.\r\n */\r\nexport async function resilientDirectQuery(\r\n  sqlText: string,\r\n  params: any[] = []\r\n): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string; rows?: any[] }> {\r\n  // Try direct pool first\r\n  try {\r\n    const pool = getDirectPool();\r\n    const result = await pool.query(sqlText, params);\r\n    return { ok: true, rows: result.rows };\r\n  } catch (directErr: unknown) {\r\n    const msg = directErr instanceof Error ? directErr.message : String(directErr);\r\n    // If it's a DNS/connection error, fall back to Prisma's PgBouncer pool\r\n    if (\r\n      msg.includes('ENOTFOUND') ||\r\n      msg.includes('ECONNREFUSED') ||\r\n      msg.includes('ECONNRESET') ||\r\n      msg.includes('getaddrinfo') ||\r\n      msg.includes('Can\\'t reach database server')\r\n    ) {\r\n      logger.warn('[DB] resilientDirectQuery: direct pool failed, falling back to Prisma', {\r\n        error: msg.substring(0, 100),\r\n      });\r\n      try {\r\n        // For parameterized queries, use $queryRawUnsafe with placeholders\r\n        if (params.length > 0) {\r\n          // Prisma's $queryRawUnsafe supports ? or $1 placeholders depending on driver\r\n          // For pg, use $1, $2, ... ΓÇö convert ? to $N\r\n          let prismaSql = sqlText;\r\n          let idx = 1;\r\n          while (prismaSql.includes('?')) {\r\n            prismaSql = prismaSql.replace('?', `$${idx}`);\r\n            idx++;\r\n          }\r\n          // For non-SELECT statements (DDL, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DO $$),\r\n          // use $executeRawUnsafe which returns affected-row count instead of\r\n          // trying to deserialize rows (which fails for INSERT ... RETURNING\r\n          // and DO blocks in PgBouncer transaction mode).\r\n          const trimmed = prismaSql.trim().toUpperCase();\r\n          const isMutation =\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('INSERT') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('UPDATE') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('DELETE') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('ALTER') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('CREATE') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('DROP') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('DO') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('BEGIN') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('COMMIT');\r\n          if (isMutation) {\r\n            await db.$executeRawUnsafe(prismaSql, ...params);\r\n            return { ok: true, rows: [] };\r\n          }\r\n          const rows = await db.$queryRawUnsafe(prismaSql, ...params);\r\n          return { ok: true, rows: rows as any[] };\r\n        } else {\r\n          const trimmed = sqlText.trim().toUpperCase();\r\n          const isMutation =\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('INSERT') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('UPDATE') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('DELETE') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('ALTER') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('CREATE') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('DROP') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('DO') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('BEGIN') ||\r\n            trimmed.startsWith('COMMIT');\r\n          if (isMutation) {\r\n            await db.$executeRawUnsafe(sqlText);\r\n            return { ok: true, rows: [] };\r\n          }\r\n          const rows = await db.$queryRawUnsafe(sqlText);\r\n          return { ok: true, rows: rows as any[] };\r\n        }\r\n      } catch (prismaErr: unknown) {\r\n        const pmsg = prismaErr instanceof Error ? prismaErr.message : String(prismaErr);\r\n        logger.error('[DB] resilientDirectQuery: Prisma fallback also failed', {\r\n          error: pmsg.substring(0, 150),\r\n        });\r\n        return { ok: false, error: `direct: ${msg.substring(0, 80)} | prisma: ${pmsg.substring(0, 80)}` };\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    // For non-DNS errors, return the direct error\r\n    return { ok: false, error: msg };\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Safe query helper.\r\n */\r\nexport async function safeQuery<T>(queryFn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<{ data: T | null; error: string | null }> {\r\n  try {\r\n    const data = await queryFn();\r\n    return { data, error: null };\r\n  } catch (err: unknown) {\r\n    const { message: msg } = getErrorInfo(err);\r\n    logger.error('[DB] Query error', { message: msg });\r\n    return { data: null, error: msg };\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport function dbErrorResponse(error: unknown) {\r\n  // FIX 3.4: Never expose internal error details to clients in production\r\n  const message = error instanceof Error ? doc.font(FONT.regular).fontSize(8).fillColor(C.textSecondary);\r\n  const textH = doc.heightOfString(description, { width: w - 42 });\r\n  doc.text(description, x + 38, y + 18, { width: w - 42 // Chart area within card (with padding)\r\n  const padLeft = 58;\r\n  const padRight = 16;\r\n  const padTop = 16;\r\n  const padBottom = 36;\r\n  const chartX = x + padLeft;\r\n  const chartY = y + const gy = chartY + chartH - (i / gridCount) * chartH;\r\n    const val = (i / gridCount) * niceMax;\r\n\r\n    // Grid line (subtle dashed appearance via thin stroke)\r\n    doc.save();\r\n PDFKit.PDFDocument,\r\n  cx: number,\r\n  cy: number,\r\n  radius: number,\r\n  data: Array<{ label: string; value: number; color: string }>,\r\n  font?: string\r\n): number {\r\n  if (!data || data.length === 0) return 0;\r\n\r\n  const fn = font || FONT.regular;\r\n  const total = data.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.value, 0);\r\n  if (total === 0) return 0;\r\n\r\n  const outerR = radius;\r\n  const innerR = radius * 0.55;\r\n  const maxSlices = 8;\r\n\r\n  // Combine small slices into \"Other\" if too many\r\n  let chartData = [...data];\r\n  if (chartData.length > maxSlices) {\r\n    const top = chartData.slice(0, maxSlices - 1);\r\n    const rest = chartData.slice(maxSlices - 1);\r\n    const otherVal = rest.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);\r\n    top.push({ label: \"Other\", (item.value / total) * 2 * Math.PI;\r\n    const endAngle = currentAngle + sliceAngle;\r\n    const cos = Math.cos;\r\n    const sin = Math.sin;\r\n\r\n    // Outer arc start and end points\r\n    const ox1 = cx + outerR * cos(currentAngle);\r\n    const oy1 = cy + outerR * sin(currentAngle);\r\n    const ox2 = cx + outerR * cos(endAngle);\r\n    const oy2 = cy + outerR * sin(endAngle);\r\n    // Inner arc points (reversed)\r\n    const ix1 = cx + innerR * cos(endAngle);\r\n    const iy1 = cy + innerR * sin(endAngle);\r\n    const ix2 = cx + innerR * cos(currentAngle);\r\n    const iy2 = cy + innerR * sin(currentAngle);\r\n\r\n    doc.save();\r\n    doc.moveTo(ox1, oy1);\r\n    (doc as PDFDocWithArc).arc(cx, cy, outerR, currentAngle, endAngle, false);\r\n    doc.lineTo(ix1, iy1);\r\n    (doc as PDFDocWithArc).arc(cx, cy, innerR, endAngle, currentAngle, true);\r\n    doc.closePath();\r\n    doc.fill(item.color);\r\n    // Subtle border\r\n    doc.lineWidth(0.5).strokeColor(C.bg).stroke();\r\n    doc.restore();\r\n\r\n    // Label on the slice (if slice is big enough)\r\n    const pct = (item.value / total) * 100;\r\n    if (pct > 5) {\r\n 0.5).fill(C.bg);\r\n  doc.restore();\r\n\r\n  // Center total value\r\n  doc.save();\r\n  doc.font(FONT.bold).fontSize(14).fillColor(C.gold);\r\n  doc.text(String(Math.round(total)), cx - 30, cy - 12, { width: 60, align: \"center\" });\r\n  doc.font(FONT.regular).fontSize(6.5).fillColor(C.textLight);\r\n  doc.text(\"TOTAL\", cx - 20, cy + 6, { width: 40, align: \"center\" });\r\n  doc.restore();\r\n\r\n  // Legend below the donut\r\n  const legendY = cy + outerR + 18;\r\n  const legendCols = Math.min(chartData.length, 4);\r\n  const colW = (radius * 2) / legendCols;\r\n  const Label\r\n    doc.save();\r\n    doc.font(fn).fontSize(6.5).fillColor(C.textSecondary);\r\n    let lbl = String(item.label || \"\");\r\n    if (lbl.length > 16) lbl = lbl.substring(0, 15) + \"ΓÇª\";\r\n    const pctTxt = ` ${lbl} (${((item.value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`;\r\n    doc.text(pctTxt, lx + 10, ly, { width: colW - 12 });\r\n    doc.restore();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  return };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction goldLine(doc: any, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, width = 0.5) {\r\n  doc.save().moveTo(x1, y1).lineTo(x2, drawSectionHeader(doc: any, y: number, title: string, subtitle?: string, W: number, P: number): number {\r\n  const CW = W - P * 2;\r\n  doc.save();\r\n  doc.roundedRect(P, y, 4, 22, newY + 16;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction ensureSpace(doc: any, y: number, needed: number, W: number, H: number, P: number): number {\r\n  if (y + needed > H - 80) {\r\n    doc.addPage();\r\n    doc.rect(0, 0,
